title: Logistic & Event Specialist
description:
**Logistics Specialist — Events, Cleaning & Facility Operations**

**Hype Siivous | Helsinki, Finland Full-time or part-time**

Hype Siivous is looking for a reliable, practical and proactive Logistics Specialist to support event preparation, cleaning and daily operations at an innovation facility hosting approximately 500–600 internal community and private events annually.

This hands-on role combines furniture setup, equipment movement, cleaning and facility support. You will take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate clearly and help leave every space safe, organised and ready for use.

Cleaning is a regular and essential part of this position. The role is not limited to event logistics or furniture preparation.

**_YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES_**

Event preparation and logistics Prepare meeting rooms and event spaces according to agreed floor plans and event requirements. Arrange tables, chairs and equipment with attention to presentation, accessibility and safe movement. Handle load-in and load-out: move furniture, equipment and supplies into and out of the venue. Move items between nearby spaces or locations, including driving when assigned. Support orderly venue entry and departure, keeping entrances, exits and circulation routes clear. Restore furniture and equipment after events. Check equipment and furniture and report damage or missing items. Follow safe lifting and handling procedures, using suitable equipment and team support.

Cleaning and facility care Clean and prepare spaces before, during and after events. Vacuum and mop floors, wipe tables, chairs and accessible surfaces, empty bins and remove ordinary waste. Carry out assigned cleaning of meeting rooms, event spaces, common areas, kitchens or kitchenettes, and washrooms. Leave spaces clean, organised and ready for their next use. Use cleaning products and equipment safely, following training and site instructions. Report maintenance needs, missing supplies and cleanliness or safety concerns.

Communication and ownership Coordinate with the Event Manager and facility team on schedules, layouts, changes and readiness. Plan and prioritise work during busy periods. Complete tasks with limited supervision while keeping colleagues informed. Provide clear handovers and report delays or unfinished tasks promptly. Follow through on commitments, take responsibility and ask for support when needed. Help coordinate practical setup tasks with colleagues when assigned.

The balance between logistics, event preparation and cleaning varies with the event schedule and facility needs. Duties are carried out within the agreed role, training and safe working practices.

**_What we are looking for_**

Relevant experience in event logistics, furniture setup, cleaning, facility operations or similar practical work. A valid category B driving licence and driving experience. Excellent practical English for understanding instructions, coordinating tasks and reporting issues. Finnish and/or Swedish language skills are an advantage, but are not required. Ability to safely perform physically demanding logistics and cleaning duties, using appropriate handling equipment and team support. Good understanding of room layouts and furniture positioning. Strong organisation, attention to detail and a cooperative attitude towards logistics and cleaning duties. Initiative, practical leadership and a strong sense of responsibility. A calm, solution-focused approach when schedules change or deadlines are tight. Ability to work independently while staying connected with the team.

Work eligibility: Applicants must have a valid right to work in Finland for this role and a lawful basis to reside in Finland. Where a residence permit is required, it must be valid and allow the work concerned. Relevant documentation will be verified before employment begins.

Preferred qualifications: An Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti) and Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi) are advantages, but are not mandatory requirements for applying.

**_Employment and working hours_**

Full-time: Permanent employment, 37.5 hours per week. Full-time work and onboarding start on 15 January 2027.

Part-time: Starts immediately and continues until further notice. Variable working hours of 0–20 hours per week. No minimum weekly hours are guaranteed.

Schedule: Monday to Saturday, with agreed early-morning, daytime or evening shifts according to event bookings. Workload varies seasonally, with greater staffing needs during busy periods. Flexibility means working agreed shifts—not being available around the clock. 6.5 hours a day.

Pay: According to the applicable collective agreement.

**_What we offer_**

A varied role combining event logistics, cleaning and facility support. An active innovation environment with community and private events. Opportunities to take ownership of practical operations and develop coordination skills. Collaboration with event management and the facility team. Onboarding into venue layouts, equipment, cleaning methods and safety procedures.

**_How to apply_**

Send your CV and a short introduction to **_employment@hypesiivous.fi_** by 31 October 2026.

Please include: Your relevant logistics, event preparation and cleaning experience. Your driving experience and licence category. Your language skills, including English and any Finnish or Swedish. Your availability and earliest starting date. Whether you are applying for part-time or full-time work. Whether you hold an Occupational Safety Card or Hygiene Passport. Confirmation of whether you currently have the right to work in Finland for this role.

Please do not send passport or residence-permit copies with your initial application. Relevant documentation will be checked securely before employment begins.

We assess applicants on their skills, experience and ability to perform the role safely.

title: Project Assistant, Metso
description:
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/c6d6529a-671b-48f7-b799-567e88253d31/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Project Assistant?

We are looking for a Project Assistant to join Metsos Document Control and Project Support team. You will be part of large international plant delivery projects, supporting delivery teams and ensuring that practical arrangements run smoothly and efficiently.

In this role, you organize travel arrangements for project personnel and customers, including flights, accommodation, and ground transportation. You prepare visa invitation letters for customers and suppliers and coordinate visa and work permit processes for project personnel across different countries.

You organize meetings both at the office and at external locations, ensuring that all arrangements are in place. You take care of ordering necessary materials such as personal protective equipment (PPE) and business gifts, and act as a key contact for travel agencies. In addition, you handle travel-related invoices and maintain up-to-date traveler profiles.

This is a full-time, one-year fixed-term position with the strong possibility of continuation. The position starts as soon as possible. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Metso. The position is based in Espoo and requires working at the office 3 days per week.

What are we looking for?

To succeed in this role, you bring a few years of experience from assistant or project support roles. You are comfortable working with MS Office tools and have experience with invoice handling and travel expense systems. You are familiar with visa and work permit processes in different countries, and you have a good understanding of travel safety and handling travel-related personal data. Fluent Finnish and English skills, both written and spoken, are essential, and additional language skills are considered an asset.

You have a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work and can prioritize effectively and adapt to changing situations. You take ownership of your responsibilities while collaborating smoothly as part of a team. Experience working in an international environment and an understanding of different cultures are considered an advantage.

Why us?

We value our dedicated and driven professionals. As an important part of our highly motivated and skilled team, you contribute directly to our shared success. We offer you an exciting opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders, supported by an open-minded, international, and friendly community of experts. Once you have a solid grasp of the job, you will have the flexibility to work partly remotely, along with excellent opportunities to develop your professional skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge company at the forefront of its industry. We're committed to your success and will provide you with a comprehensive onboarding and a supportive environment where you can truly thrive. We offer occupational healthcare and a lunch benefit as employee benefits.

Are you interested?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application either in English or Finnish via the link by 23.10.2026. The interviewing process will begin during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide relocation assistance to Finland.

title: Embedded electronics and integration engineer
description:
**Role summary**

You are a hands-on electronics engineer focused on fast build–assemble–test–integrate cycles for reference models and NRE projects. Your work shortens iteration loops and increases throughput across multiple customer deliveries, ensuring hardware modules are built and validated reliably.

**What youll do**

- Assemble and bring up PCBs and modules; validate electrical and optical subsystems against defined checks and acceptance criteria.Debug hardware issues efficiently (power, signals, timing, communication, sensor behavior) and document findings and fixes.

- Support integration with firmware/software teams, including effective data sharing on interfaces such as UART/SPI/I²C, timing coordination, power modes, and logging/telemetry.

- Maintain practical test setups and measurement pipelines: fixtures, rigs, scripts, checklists, build documentation, and bench discipline to ensure repeatable results and smooth transfer to manufacturing.

- Interact with manufacturing and component partners to support builds, resolve issues, and improve build quality and consistency.

- Contribute to next-generation hardware concepts through component evaluations, sensor/illumination experiments, and new integration approaches — improving delivery speed and reducing rework across NRE and customer builds.


**What we expect**

- Strong hands-on competence in embedded electronics: PCB/module assembly, bring-up, debugging, and systematic fault isolation.

- Comfort with lab instrumentation and measurement workflows (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters; building reliable test routines).

- Practical understanding of embedded interfaces and system integration constraints (UART/SPI/I²C, timing, power, signal integrity at a working level).

- Documentation discipline: you leave behind clear build notes, checklists, and test procedures others can repeat.

- Ability to work independently in a small team, prioritize effectively, and unblock others quickly.

- Experience with optical/IR components, cameras, illumination, or sensor systems is a plus.

- Embedded programming experience (including FPGA-adjacent and HDL work) is a plus, but not required.


**What we offer**

- A core role in building and validating real hardware in a deep-tech company shipping demanding sensing systems.

- Direct impact on delivery speed, reliability, and customer success; close collaboration with the founders and the core engineering team.

- Variety of work across reference designs, customer NRE builds, and next-generation prototypes.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience; potential equity participation depending on role seniority and responsibilities.

- A culture that values technical rigor, clear communication, and practical execution over bureaucracy.

- Comprehensive health-care package, gym access


**Details**

Reporting to: Chief Technology Officer

Location: Joensuu, Finland, on-site work

Travel: Infrequent

Work authorization: Relocation assistance provided

**Send or submit your CV and portfolio.**

title: Operations Manager for Lapland Luxury DMC
description:
Lapland Luxury DMC is a private destination management company (DMC) specialising in tailor-made luxury experiences in Lapland. Our portfolio includes Hidden Arctic Cloud Villas, located approximately 30 minutes from Rovaniemi city centre, AINO Private Island, and other exclusive luxury villas.

We are now looking for a passionate and experienced Operations Manager to lead and develop our operations in Lapland Luxury DMC and ensure exceptional experiences for our international guests.

**About the role:**

As an Operations Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth daily operations and high-quality delivery of Lapland Luxury's exclusive experiences and services.

You will lead your team, coordinate operational resources, and work closely with other departments to ensure that every guest experience meets our high standards. In this role, you will combine hands-on operational leadership with a proactive approach to developing our services, processes, and ways of working.

**Your key responsibilities include:**

- Operational management – overseeing the daily operations, quality, and delivery of Lapland Luxury's services and guest experiences.

- Team leadership and development – recruiting, onboarding, training, and supervising team members while fostering a positive and service-oriented working environment.

- Resource planning and coordination – ensuring effective scheduling and coordination of operational resources to support seamless service delivery.

- Guest experience and customer relationships – maintaining exceptional service standards, managing guest-related matters, and continuously improving customer satisfaction.

- Service and event coordination – planning and coordinating tailored experiences, activities, and events in close collaboration with other departments and partners.

- Continuous improvement – actively developing operational processes, service quality, and efficiency to ensure the fulfilment of our customer promise.


**What we expect from you:**

We are looking for a confident, hands-on leader who thrives in a dynamic hospitality environment and is passionate about delivering outstanding guest experiences.

To succeed in this role, we value:

- Previous experience in operational management, hospitality or tourism

- Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to motivate, support, and develop a team.

- Excellent organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.

- A genuine passion for exceptional customer service and attention to detail.

- A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership and make decisions independently.

- Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and build lasting customer relationships.

- Fluency in English; other languages are considered an advantage.

- Good digital skills and the ability to manage operational systems and processes.


We expect you to have previous experience in luxury hospitality, destination management, or Arctic programme services, along with a solid understanding of delivering high-quality guest experiences.

**What we offer:**

At Lapland Luxury, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop exceptional hospitality experiences in one of the most unique destinations in the world.

We offer you:

- A diverse and responsible management role within an exclusive luxury hospitality environment.

- The opportunity to make a real impact on operational excellence, guest experiences, and service development.

- A supportive and collaborative team within the SantaPark Arctic World.

- The opportunity to work with international guests and unique, tailor-made luxury experiences.

- Professional development opportunities and the chance to grow your leadership expertise.

- An inspiring working environment surrounded by the extraordinary nature of Finnish Lapland.

- Full-time, permanent contract

- Employee benefits across the SantaPark Arctic World group.


Position will be filled as soon as the right person is found so please send your application soon - We are excited to hear from you!

title: IT-Manager
description:
SantaPark Arctic World on matkailu ja elämysalan yritys, jonka toiminnan ytimessä ovat ainutlaatuiset elämykset, lämminhenkinen palvelu ja intohimo erinomaisuuteen. Konserniimme kuuluvat SantaPark – Christmas Theme Park, Santa Claus Secret Forest – Joulukka, Arctic TreeHouse Hotel, Rakas Restaurant & Bar, Hidden Arctic Cloud Villas, AINO Private Island sekä Lapland Luxury DMC.

Tavoitteenamme on luoda vieraillemme elinikäisiä muistoja. Haluamme tarjota myös henkilöstöllemme innostavan työympäristön, jossa on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja rakentaa yhdessä jotakin ainutlaatuista.

Etsimme kokenutta ja kehittämishenkistä IT Manageria vastaamaan konsernimme IT-ympäristön toimivuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät IT-kokonaisuuksien hallinta, kehitysprojektit ja käytännönläheinen ongelmanratkaisu. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä konsernin CTO, ulkoisen IT-palvelukumppanin ja liiketoimintayksiköidemme kanssa varmistaen, että teknologiset ratkaisumme tukevat sujuvaa arkea ja korkeatasoista asiakaskokemusta.

**Keskeiset vastuualueesi:**

- Konsernin IT-ympäristön, järjestelmien, laitteiden ja infrastruktuurin hallinta ja kehittäminen

- IT-strategian toteuttaminen, IT-budjetin seuranta ja kehityshankkeiden koordinointi

- Tietoturvan, tietosuojan ja järjestelmien toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen

- IT-palvelukumppaneiden, toimittajasuhteiden ja palvelutasojen hallinta

- Järjestelmäkäyttöönottojen, integraatioiden ja muiden IT-projektien johtaminen

- Henkilöstön IT-tuen sujuvuuden varmistaminen sekä vaativampien teknisten haasteiden ratkaiseminen


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä IT-alan ammattilaista, joka hallitsee laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja tarttuu tarvittaessa myös käytännön tekemiseen.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa IT-alan koulutusta tai vastaavaa työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista

- Vahvaa kokemusta IT-ympäristöjen hallinnasta ja kehittämisestä sekä vastuullisista IT-tehtävistä

- Hyvää osaamista verkoista, pilvipalveluista, tietoturvasta ja liiketoimintajärjestelmistä

- Kokemusta IT-projektien johtamisesta, toimittajayhteistyöstä ja kustannusten hallinnasta

- Itsenäistä ja kehittämisorientoitunutta työotetta sekä hyviä yhteistyö- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


Arvostamme kokemusta matkailu-, majoitus- tai palvelualalta sekä ymmärrystä sesonkiluonteisen liiketoiminnan erityispiirteistä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän ainutlaatuisessa matkailualan konsernissa

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa konsernin IT-ratkaisuihin ja kehittää toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti

- Itsenäisen roolin ja tiivistä yhteistyötä eri liiketoimintojen, johdon ja IT-asiantuntijoiden kanssa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja kasvaa ammatillisesti

- Innostavan ja yhteistyöhenkisen työyhteisön sekä SantaPark Arctic Worldin henkilöstöedut


Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja työskentelypaikkasi sijaitsee Rovaniemellä. Työhön sisältyy liikkumista konsernin eri toimipisteiden välillä. Raportoit tehtävässä talousjohtajallemme.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ansioluetteloineen viimeistään 26.10.2026 - Odotamme innolla kuulevamme sinusta!

title: Aana Palvelut Oy, Henkilökohtainen avustaja Huittisiin
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa saat samalla vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi?
Haluatko työn, joka mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi eikä vaadi aiempaa koulutusta tai pitkää työkokemusta?
Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

title: Site Engineers (Multiple Disciplines), Granlund
description:
Are you ready to take an active role in site supervision across demanding international projects? We are now looking for Site Engineers across several technical disciplines to join Granlunds growing Site Services team.

Granlund is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/547f419b-5389-4d1d-9b3c-4499da3384d1/original.png]

Would you be one of our new Site Engineers?
As a Site Engineer, you will be responsible for site supervision within your own technical discipline, whether your expertise lies in Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical, ICT, Security, Automation, or Moisture Management. As the client's technical representative on site, you will play a key role in ensuring that technically demanding projects are executed according to approved plans, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and agreed quality standards.

In your daily work, you will monitor project progress, review installations, materials, and work phases, and ensure that execution aligns with approved plans and technical requirements. You will interpret technical drawings and project documentation, document your observations in digital systems, and help ensure that any quality issues or deviations are addressed appropriately. As a key link between the site and the wider project organization, you will provide accurate and up-to-date information on project progress and site activities.

The positions are full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The work is strongly site-based, with projects located throughout Finland. The most suitable project location will be discussed during the recruitment process. The role requires regular presence at project sites and readiness to travel.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for professionals who enjoy working close to construction and industrial projects and want to take responsibility for quality and technical execution on site. You have experience in site supervision, quality control, or technical project environments, along with a relevant engineering degree and the ability to interpret technical drawings, plans, and project documentation.

Your background may, for example, be in Civil, Structural or Architectural Engineering, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical Engineering, ICT, Security, Automation or Moisture Management. Regardless of your discipline, you have a few years of experience working on construction or industrial projects and are comfortable operating in a site-based environment.

Experience with Dalux or Autodesk Construction Cloud is considered an advantage. Fluent English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. You will also need a valid driving licence and readiness to work regularly at project sites.

You are proactive, quality-conscious, and eager to develop your expertise. You take responsibility for your work, communicate effectively with different stakeholders, and are not afraid to raise concerns when quality, safety, or project requirements are at risk.

Why join us?
At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

Are you interested?
Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 18.10.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period may close the job posting earlier if the positions are filled.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (nea.repo@biisoni.fi [nea.repo@biisoni.fi]).

title: Chef, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, Kittilä
description:
StaffPoint is looking for CHEFS for the winter season 2026–2027 at Lapland Hotels SnowVillage.

Every year in November, a unique frozen experience is built in Lainio, covering an area of about 2 hectares. It features stunning ice sculptures, an ice restaurant and an ice bar. Reception and kitchen facilities, however, are warmly housed within log walls. The SnowVillage attracts around 80,000 visitors annually and its theme changes every year. Located near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts, the location ensures a vibrant winter season. The distance is approx. 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The position includes duties in both à la carte and buffet kitchen operations. Employment is scheduled to begin on 23 November 2026 and continue until approximately 4 April 2027. Full-time work is available, with 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be signed between the employee and StaffPoint. Please note that the Lapland Hotels chain is a smoke-free workplace.

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a kitchen as a chef

- Creativity, initiative, and a positive attitude that is reflected in your way of working

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

What we offer:

- A lively and international work environment

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A great, close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Salary based on your experience, at least in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES)

Accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so having your own car or a valid driving licence will be considered an advantage.

How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

Email: pohjoinen@staffpoint.fi

title: Kock
description:
**Kock**

Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 24 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en kock till vår restaurang och bar. I Restaurangen och baren arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Vi serverar a la carte, konferenslunch och bistro. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat och dryck och vi kan från hösten 2026 även stoltsera med vårt egna bryggeri.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Vi söker dig som har stor noggrannhet och tycker om att laga god mat från grunden. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- A la carte

- Konferenslunch

- Bistro

- Följa vår egenkontrollplan

- Övriga förekommande köksuppgifter

- Beställningar


**Personliga egenskaper**

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. Som person är du positiv, ansvarstagande, stresstålig, har lätt för att samarbeta och har förståelse för att alla arbetskamrater är värdefulla. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Du behöver ha köksutbildning eller några års erfarenhet av tidigare arbete med tillagning av a la carte/bistro. Hygienpass är ett krav och vi önskar att du kan svenska eller engelska. Du bör vara minst 20 år fyllda.

**Varaktighet**

Tjänsten är en tillsvidare anställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Köksjobbet är skiftesarbete med ett rullande arbetsschema med främst kvällspass under veckans alla dagar.

**Lön**

Lön enligt överenskommelse

Vi ser framemot att läsa din ansökan och hoppas du skickar in den tillsammans med din CV redan idag till jobb@parkalandia.com. Sista ansökningsdag är den 31.10.2026, men intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och platsen kan bli tillsatta innan sista ansökningsdag. Har du frågor kontakta köksmästare Rune på telefon 018-14130.

title: Sähköalan ammattilainen – vastuullinen rooli teollisuudessa
description:

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu monipuoliset tehtävät sähkökunnossapidon parissa - poikkeamien raportointia, instrumentointia, päivittäistä kunnossapitoa, asennuksia, huoltotoimenpiteitä ja erilaisia projektitehtäviä. Tulet täydentämään nykyistä kunnossapito-organisaatiota ja tässä tehtävässä saat loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi, jos sinulla on halu ja motivaatio oppia alasta lisää. title: Mechanical Engineer, Konecranes
description:
We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and contribute to some of the world's most demanding crane engineering projects.

Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/49cf9064-f425-4d1c-b5e9-ecfdc64d4c69/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Mechanical Engineer?

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and work on some of the world's largest and most technically demanding crane projects.

Your responsibilities include structural analyses, strength calculations and mechanical design throughout both the tendering and project execution phases. You will perform strength analyses, mass, cross-sectional and machinery calculations, transportation and erection analyses, and support design decisions by interpreting standards, specifications and customer requirements.

Working closely with designers, project teams and customers, you will contribute to solving complex engineering challenges while gradually taking on broader technical responsibilities. The role offers a unique opportunity to develop towards future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities with support from experienced senior engineering professionals.

The position is full-time and employed through Biisoni. The role offers flexible working hours, a hybrid working model with approximately one office day per week in Hyvinkää, and international travel of around 30-60 days per year.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an engineer with experience in strength analysis and steel structures. Your background may come from industrial machinery, mobile equipment, heavy industrial equipment, steel structures, or similar engineering environments.

To succeed in this role, you have a good understanding of structural mechanics, strength calculations, dynamic analysis and mechanical design as well as the ability to interpret 2D engineering drawings. A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, with major in Machine Design, Steel Structures, Engineering Mechanics or similar is preferred, but candidates with relevant practical experience are also encouraged to apply.

Experience with Finnsap, NX, Simcenter, Ansys, or similar engineering tools is considered an advantage. Strong communication skills in English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus. As a person, you are analytical, proactive and eager to learn. You enjoy solving technical challenges, taking ownership and developing your expertise over the long term.

Why us?

Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes business offers a highly specialised engineering environment where every project is unique. You will work on some of the worlds largest and most technically advanced shipyard cranes, learn from experienced experts and build expertise in demanding structural engineering and strength analysis. The role provides a clear development path towards broader engineering responsibility and future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities in an international project environment.

Have we got your interest?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.10.2026. We review applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. The employment relationship will be established with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant, via email at saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].

title: Gen B Graduate Program, Process Development Engineer
description:
Start your future at one of Europe’s leading mining- and smelting companies and become part of Gen B! Begin a one-year journey designed to challenge and inspire you. As a graduate, you will gain in-depth, hands-on experience across different business areas, functions, and sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Portugal or Ireland, depending on your chosen position.  



To drive change for future generations, we need new ways of thinking, that’s why we encourage you to apply. You are the hearts behind tomorrow.  



A program designed for your future

For one year, divided into three periods, you will explore how Boliden operates end to end, and how your own unique background and experience connect to the bigger picture. As a graduate, you are employed in a permanent position from day one and supported by an individual development program. Throughout the year several engaged and experienced colleagues, will guide you in your progress. You will become part of an international network of graduates and colleagues, expanding both your knowledge and connections. Six joint training weeks with top-class lecturers will challenge your thinking and give you the opportunity to further deepen your skills. After graduation you will continue your journey with a mentor for six months. In addition, you will receive practical training in project methodology and Boliden’s production methods, enabling you to apply what you learn directly in our operations.

Learn more how you can step into a future where raw material meets your potential. 

Find your path

As a graduate and part of Gen B, you will be given a unique gateway into Boliden. Whether you want to grow as an expert in business, engineering or tech, you will get the opportunity to grow in the area that excites you the most.  

In this role as a Process Development Engineer, you'll be part of the the R&D team at Harjavalta smelter, supporting production operations and, when needed, investment projects. You will solve process-related challenges, contribute to long-term assignments linked to strategic objectives, and collaborate closely with production, maintenance, and project personnel.

Responsibilities:

    Respond promptly to requests from production and help resolve process-related problems

    Support production operations and contribute to investment projects when needed

    Contribute to longer-term assignments linked to the company’s strategic objectives

    Combine rapid operational problem-solving with systematic long-term planning

    Review historical reports, external research, and industry publications and assess their relevance to Harjavalta smelter

    Document trials, new materials, operating-window changes, results, and lessons learned for future use

    Collaborate with production, maintenance, and project personnel on process development initiatives

Qualifications: 

    Master of Science in metallurgy, sustainable process metallurgy, extractive metallurgy, process engineering, chemical engineering, process chemistry, or a closely related field



Who you are

We think you are a forward thinker and a team thriver, who is naturally curious, and solutions oriented. You communicate with honesty and respect, are eager to take initiative and dedicated to follow through. Above all, you are ready to take responsibility and grow as an expert. 

What you bring

You hold a relevant university degree completed in 2025 or later. You can communicate clearly in English, hold a valid driver’s license and are available to start in September 2027.

How to apply

Submit your application and CV in English. The recruitment process includes assessments, interviews, and a final Assessment Center for selected candidates.

The Assessment Center will take place in Stockholm, Sweden, on one day between February 16-19, 2027. Boliden will cover travel and accommodation expenses. Please ensure your availability between February 14-20, 2027, if you progress to the final stage.

About Boliden

Boliden is at the forefront of advancing our industry through sustainable solutions and innovation. Every day, we work to reduce our footprint, and drive long-term progress. We are on a journey towards becoming the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. With us, you will be part of a diverse workplace built on care, courage and responsibility. We work together to grow and take the lead. Our priority is your safety, well-being and growth. Make a lasting impact, in your everyday work, for future generations. Let a rock-solid career start with us.

Learn more at www.boliden.com.



Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

Do you have any questions about your application? Please send an e-mail to genb@boliden.com. Last day to apply for this position is November 20th 2026. Selection will be ongoing; we are looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

If you are a representative of a recruiting firm, please refrain from contacting us about this posting. We appreciate your consideration.

title: Legal Trainees @ Stora Enso
description:
**Are you a law student who:**

- is eager to gain experience in varying legal tasks in an international environment?

- has previous experience working in a law firm or an in-house legal department?

- is at least halfway through your law studies? If you responded **YES** to all three questions, this position might be for you!


We are looking for **two Legal Trainees** to join **Stora Enso** for a 12-month fixed-term position. The first Legal Trainee term is scheduled to start in January 2027, and the second in September 2027. In your application, please indicate which term you are applying for or which term you would prefer. The position is full-time and based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki. Although this is a full-time role, there's flexibility for you to attend lectures and exams when necessary.

**In your day-to-day work**, you will gain comprehensive insights into different areas of the legal function and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across Stora Enso. You will support legal counsels with a range of day-to-day tasks, including conducting legal research, preparing corporate documents (e.g., AGM materials), and drafting, negotiating, and reviewing agreements (e.g., non-disclosure agreements). You will also work on compliance matters, including policy administration and contributing to AI-related projects.

In this role, you will work directly with internal stakeholders and take ownership of assignments independently, with the support of your colleagues whenever needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a law student to broaden their knowledge and develop practical skills across different areas of law.

**This position is a perfect fit for you if you have:**

- at least 180 credits of completed legal studies and a background in diverse legal tasks from previous internships;

- a proactive and self-driven approach to accomplishing tasks and an ability to learn quickly;

- an analytical mindset and the competence to prioritize conflicting demands from multiple business clients in a fast-paced environment;

- a curious mindset and a strong willingness to learn; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required.


**Stora Enso offers you:**

- a unique opportunity to learn about the tasks and responsibilities of the legal department within an international corporation;

- a possibility to work on versatile assignments with highly skilled professionals;

- modern, high-quality office spaces in a prime location; and

- a diverse working culture with a low hierarchy and support from your team when needed.


_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso creates better choices for society by accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

**Did we pique your interest?**

If this sounds like the perfect next career move for you, please send us your CV, cover letter, and up-to-date transcript of studies by **20 October 2026** to get the conversation going! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact our recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

**P.S.: Apply as soon as possible** – we will start reviewing applications and getting to know candidates already during the application period.

title: Ethics & Compliance Counsel @ Stora Enso
description:
**Hey Ethics & Compliance professional!**

Are you looking for a diverse role in ethics and compliance within a listed company? Would you be excited to join a team where your work helps build a more sustainable future?

If you are thinking **YES**, please keep reading because we are now looking for **a Legal Counsel, Ethics & Compliance** to join **Stora Enso's Ethics and Compliance Team**!

**In this role**, as a member of the Ethics and Compliance team, you will work with assignments on group level, and, at the same time, serve as the dedicated Ethics and Compliance resource for one or several of Stora Enso's Business Areas. More specifically, you will:

- Serve as the dedicated E&C resource for assigned Business Area(s), providing proactive and reactive legal support including risk assessments, policy interpretation, and compliance investigations

- Monitor relevant regulatory developments in Finland and across the EU, covering anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations

- Draft, update, and implement E&C policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent understanding and application across the organisation

- Develop and deliver E&C training and awareness initiatives, both in person, online and through e-learning programmes

- Contribute as an integrated member of the Group E&C team, taking ownership of group-level projects and supporting the Chief Compliance Officer as needed


Together with your team, you will also attempt to manage information in digital form by using AI, and thus continuously work towards making the routines more efficient and better.

**The Ethics and Compliance team** consists of 6 professionals in several global locations. The team is spread across multiple locations but operates as a genuinely close-knit group, with strong connections and active day-to-day collaboration across geographies. Team members support one another and are encouraged to challenge each other constructively. This is a team where you are expected to contribute, grow, and be heard - ambition is welcomed, and opportunities for development are real.

The position is based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki, but the position also involves occasional, pre-planned travel, mostly within Europe. You will report to the Chief Compliance Officer, who is based in Sweden.

**This position is a great fit for a candidate who has:**

- a Finnish law degree or other education and experience the employer deems relevant for this position;

- at least five years of relevant experience in ethics and compliance in an international environment, whether in-house or at a law firm;

- a strong knowledge of competition law, anti-corruption, trade sanctions, grievance handling and investigations, as well as business ethics and corporate values more broadly;

- a good understanding of the fast-moving regulatory landscape relevant to corporate ethics and compliance, including developments at both the Finnish and EU levels, particularly in the areas of anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations;

- project management experience and experience of rolling out cross-functional programmes in international organisations;

- proven integrity and high ethical standards as well as a strong drive to get things done and the ability to perform well under pressure and meet tight deadlines;

- strong interpersonal skills and a team player mindset; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required. Additional language skills, such as Swedish, German, Polish, Dutch or Chinese, are considered an advantage.


**What Stora Enso offers you:**

**A place for professional growth:** Stora Enso's innovative and high-speed environment offers you an opportunity to constantly develop professionally at all stages of your career.

**A diverse working culture:** You get to be part of highly skilled team within an international corporation where everyone is treated fairly and with respect.

**A commitment to sustainability:** Sustainability is at the core of Stora Enso's everyday activities, reflecting a strong commitment to compliance and doing things the right way.

**Benefits to support your well-being:** Besides industry-standard salary, you will receive a wide scale of benefits to support your health and well-being – of which we are happy to tell you more in our conversations.

_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. They believe that everything that is made from fossil-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and their sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion. Stora Enso shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Oy (STEAV, STERV) and Nasdaq Stockholm AB (STE A, STE R). In addition, the shares are traded in the USA as ADRs (SEOAY)._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

title: Vibration Engineer
description:
We are looking for aVibration Engineerwith a main responsibility for delivering noise and vibration engineering analyses,measurementsand solutions for marine projects during the sales and project execution phases. The preferred location for this permanent position isVaasa, Finland.We offer possibility for hybrid work.

Your role and responsibilities

As aVibration Engineer, you will work in a global,innovativeand customer-driven organisation.This delivery-oriented role focuseson providing high-quality engineering analysis and solutionsthatmeet projectneedsand customerexpectations. Your work may include performing noise and vibration measurements during factory acceptance testing of generating sets for advanced passenger and research vessels, as well as presenting vibration analysis results and selected power transmission solutions forcutting-edgehybrid ferry projects. You willbe working as part of our skilled Noise & Vibration Engineering team within Customer Solution Engineering in Power Supply,providing specialistexpertiseacross all marine projects.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Perform noise and vibration measurements during engine factory acceptance tests
* Participatein delivery projects as the Noise & Vibration Engineer in the project team

* M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or another relevant engineering field

* Fundamental knowledge of structural dynamics,vibrationand modal analysis
* Interest in internal combustion engines
* Fluent written and spoken English and solid MS Office skills. Finnish orSwedish language skill is considered as an advantage
* Analytical mindset and a systematic,proactiveand organised way of working
* Practical problem-solving approach and strong technical reporting skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international environment, with willingness to learn and adoptnew technologies


The following are considered an advantage:

* Knowledge of signal processing

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

title: Aana Palvelut Oy, Henkilökohtainen avustaja Poriin
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa saat samalla vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi?
Haluatko työn, joka mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi eikä vaadi aiempaa koulutusta tai pitkää työkokemusta?
Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

title: Project Engineer (electrical and automation), Wärtsilä, Vaasa
description:

As a Project Engineer, you will manage technical automation solutions, oversee schedules, budgets, and quality standards, and support the project manager in coordinating tasks across stakeholders. title: Palvelukoordinaattori / ANNU sosiaalipalvelut, Pirkanmaa
description:
ANNU sosiaalipalvelut etsii oma-aloitteista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä palvelukoordinaattoria kokoaikaiseen tehtävään kotiin vietäviin sosiaalipalveluihin Pirkanmaalle.

Työ koostuu palvelutoiminnan koordinoinnista ja asiakastyöstä. Koordinointitehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, rekrytointi, työntekijöiden ja asiakkuuksien käytännön järjestelyt sekä muut hallinnolliset tehtävät. Tehtävässä toimitaan palvelujohtajan alaisuudessa.

**Asiakastyön osuus on lähtökohtaisesti noin 50 prosenttia työajasta. Osuus voi toiminnan tarpeiden mukaan kasvaa enintään 100 prosenttiin.** Asiakastyöhön kuuluvat perhetyö ja tehostettu perhetyö, ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö sekä tuettu asuminen.

Työ tehdään Tampereen toimipisteellämme Ratinassa ja asiakaskohteissa Pirkanmaan alueella. Tehtävässä ei ole etätyömahdollisuutta. Koordinointityö ajoittuu pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin klo 8–16. **Asiakastyötä tehdään myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.**

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa sosiaali- tai terveysalan AMK-tutkintoa ja tehtävän edellyttämää voimassa olevaa ammattioikeutta. Lisäksi odotamme:

- hyviä asiakaspalvelu-, viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja kykyä asioida englanniksi; ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi

- valmiutta käyttää asiakastietojärjestelmiä ja oppia uusia järjestelmiä

- oma-aloitteista ja itsenäistä työotetta

- hyviä organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja

- joustavuutta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa.


Aikaisempi kokemus koordinointitehtävistä ja kotiin vietävistä sosiaalipalveluista katsotaan eduksi. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on eduksi asiakastyössä. Tarjoamme merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn, kattavan perehdytyksen sekä esihenkilön ja tiimin tuen. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden myös pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Palkka määräytyy yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaluokan **G24D** mukaan. Kuukausipalkka on hyväksyttävästä palvelusajasta riippuen **2 811,09–3 071,09 euroa**. Lisäksi maksetaan TES mukaiset työaikalisät.

Palveluslisään oikeuttava työkokemus arvioidaan TES mukaisesti työtodistusten perusteella. Huomioon otetaan tehtävässä olennaisesti hyödyttävä aikaisempi työkokemus.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Sopivan henkilön löydyttyä valinta voidaan tehdä ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Käytämme ensimmäisen kierroksen haastatteluissa Teams-yhteyttä.

Lisätiedot: Tiina Helin, **tiina@annu.fi**, **044 901 8526**.

title: Svenskspråkig vårdare åt sympatisk kund på Kimitoön
description:
**Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**

Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund på Kimitoön

Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!

Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**

Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Vad gör en vård helppare?**

En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.

Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

- hjälp vid dusch

- uppföljning av hur senioren mår

- stöd för att klara sig hemma

- stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet


Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.

**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**

Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.

Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.

Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?

Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:

Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.

Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.

Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.

Som vård helppare får du:

- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap.

- **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka.

- **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning.

- **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön!


Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.

**Skicka in din ansökan som vårdare-helpper här.**

**Läs mer om Hemby genom att klicka här.**

Om du har frågor om att bli vårdare-helpper, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

title: Aarre Avustajat - Henkilökohtainen avustaja - Keski-Uusimaa
description:
Etsitkö mukavaa ja joustavaa palkkatyötä ilman koulutus- tai tutkintovaatimusta? Haluatko itse vaikuttaa omaan työmäärääsi sekä siihen, missä ja milloin työskentelet? Koetko muiden ihmisten auttamisen tärkeäksi ja haluat tehdä työtä, josta jää hyvä mieli?

Mikäli vastasit yllä oleviin kysymyksiin kyllä, suosittelemme sinulle henkilökohtaisen avustajan töitä Aarre Avustajilla. Alta löydät lisätietoja Aarre Avustajista ja henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä sekä linkin työnhakulomakkeeseen, jonka kautta voit hakea meille helposti töihin ilman erillistä CV:tä. Otathan rohkeasti yhteyttä, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää!

Helposti täytettävän työnhakulomakkeen löydät tästä linkistä: https://www.tuntinetti.fi/AarreAvustajatHakulomake.html

TÖITÄ TARJOLLA HENKILÖKOHTAISENA AVUSTAJANA
Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme uusia henkilökohtaisia avustajia tärkeään, mutta joustavaan avustustyöhön. Työ on palkkatyötä yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja sopii niin kokopäiväistä, osa-aikaista, satunnaista kuin keikkatyötäkin etsivälle hyvälle tyypille. Henkilökohtaisena avustajana saat itse määritellä, kuinka paljon ja milloin työskentelet, joten avustajan työ sopii myös toisen työn tai opiskelun ohelle. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla erityistä koulutusta avustajan työhön, vaan oikea asenne ja luotettavuus ovat tärkeimmät ominaisuudet erinomaiselle henkilökohtaiselle avustajalle. Aarre Avustajilla saat jatkuvan tuen ja ohjauksen omalta toimihenkilöltäsi, etkä jää koskaan asioittesi tai kysymyksiesi kanssa yksin, sen lupaamme.

MITÄ HENKILÖKOHTAINEN APU ON JA MITÄ AVUSTAJA TEKEE?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, jossa henkilökohtainen avustaja toimii asiakkaan käsinä ja jalkoina toteuttaen niitä toimia, jotka asiakas tekisi itse, mutta ei niistä vamman tai sairauden vuoksi selviä yksin. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on auttaa asiakasta jokapäiväisissä arjen tehtävissä niin kotona kuin myös kodin ulkopuolella.

Avustustehtävät ovat usein tavallisia arkisia askareita, joita me kaikki toteutamme myös omassa arjessamme. Avustajan työhön ei siten sisälly tehtäviä, jotka vaativat erillistä, esimerkiksi lähihoitajan tutkintoa, vaan kuka tahansa voi toimia avustajana. Avustustehtäviä ovat esimerkiksi asiakkaan avustaminen kaupassa käynnissä, ulkoilussa, ruokailussa tai ruoanlaitossa, pukeutumisessa, harrastuksissa tai kodinhoidossa.

MILLAINEN HENKILÖ SOPII AVUSTAJAKSI?
Voimme useiden satojen henkilökohtaisten avustajien työnantajana todeta, että henkilökohtaisiksi avustajiksi sopivat parhaiten henkilöt, joilla on oikea asenne tärkeää avustamistyötä kohtaan. Avustajan on hyvä olla luotettava, positiivinen, avulias, ahkera ja ihmisläheinen henkilö.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla aikaisempaa vastaavaa työkokemusta, sillä jokainen uusi avustaja perehdytetään kattavalla perehdytyksellä Aarre Avustajien omassa Aarre Akatemiassa ennen työn aloittamista. Avustamis- ja hoiva-alan kokemuksesta tai koulutuksesta voi kuitenkin olla hyötyä joidenkin asiakkaiden kohdalla.

MILLAISIA TYÖVUOROJA ON TARJOLLA JA VOINKO ITSE VAIKUTTAA NIIHIN?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, joka tapahtuu niin arkisin kuin myös viikonloppuisin ja mahdollisia työvuoroja on usein tarjolla aamusta iltaan. Aarre Avustajilla voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, miten paljon ja milloin haluat työskennellä sekä millaiselle asiakkaalle. Pyrimme yhdistämään asiakkaidemme avustajatarpeet ja avustajiemme työtoiveet niin, että ne sopivat kaikille. Saat aina tavata mahdollisen uuden asiakkaan ennen asiakassuhteen aloittamista, ja mikäli koet, että jokin asia ei toimi niin kuin ajattelit, voimme yhdessä etsiä sinulle sopivan vaihtoehdon. Meillä voit tehdä halutessasi avustajan töitä niin monelle asiakkaalle kuin itse haluat.

HAKEMINEN
Rekrytointimme on jatkuvaa, joten täytäthän työnhakulomakkeen tarkasti. Muista lisätä työnhakulomakkeeseen kaikki sinulle sopivat kunnat, joissa voit työskennellä, niin osaamme olla sinuun yhteydessä heti, kun löydämme sinulle sopivan asiakkaan. Työnhakulomakkeen täyttäminen ei vielä sido sinua mihinkään.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

description:
Vår franska trädgårdsfirma, Jardin Riviera, utgår utanför Nice på Franska Rivieran och arbetar i ett område på cirka 30 km.

Vi söker mer personal med heltidstjänst på tillsvidareanställning då vi har mer än fullt upp med våra projekt i olika trädgårdar.

Under vinterhalvåret bygger vi mycket trädgårdar och under sommarhalvåret är det underhåll som gäller. Vi utför i stort sett alla arbetsuppgifter som uppkommer i en trädgård.

Ni kan läsa mer om företaget och hur vi jobbar på vår hemsida www.jardinriviera.com

Vi behöver en morgonpigg, positiv och glad person som gillar att ta del av teamets kunskaper och vår service.

Du är proaktiv, ansvarstagande, har god lyssningsförmåga, visar nyfikenhet och är bra på att interagera och planera ditt arbete.

Vi letar efter dig som sätter ett värde i att utföra arbetet på bästa möjliga vis och som inte är rädd för att hugga i när och där det behövs.

För att lyckas och trivas i tjänsten behöver du vara serviceinriktad och ta ansvar för att hålla hög kvalitet i det arbete du utför.

Vi tror också att du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och att du har lätt för att samarbeta.

För oss är det viktigt att ha ett trevligt och glatt bemötande, både mot varandra såväl som kunderna samt att ha ett intresse för trädgårdar.

B-körkort är ett måste då vi använder bilar för att ta oss till våra kunder.

Du ska förutom svenska även kunna prata engelska då nästan all kommunikation sker på engelska, franska är självklart en bra merit.

Detta är heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning, inte ett sommarjobb.

Om detta kan vara av intresse, lägg en mail till oss på info@jardinriviera.com där du berättar om dig själv samt erfarenhet osv.

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig! ☀️🌴

Jardin Riviera
