title: Mechanics Designer, New Business, Access Control Solutions
description:
Mechanics Designer, New Business, Access Control Solutions

Job Description

Mechanics Designer, New Business, Access Control E&M

Do you want to make a change and be a part of creating a smarter and safer world for everyone? Are you looking for a stable employer with a long-term growth? We have delivered several groundbreaking products that have made an impact on perceived safety and look forward to pioneering many more. We offer you the opportunity to develop in your role at a world leading company using cutting edge technology.

The New Business Access Control Solutions team at Axis are now looking for a Mechanical Designer to join us at our HQ in Lund, Sweden.

Who is your future team?

We are a team of 13 positive, forward-thinking individuals who highly value teamwork and each other. Our team comprises of both Mechanics and Electronics engineers, working cross-functionally and collaborating with various departments on a daily basis. We are responsible for one out of the three product areas at New Business, specifically Access Control.

Our team is a blend of highly experienced designers and recent graduates, as we believe that great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time. We foster an open environment where each team member takes the time to help colleagues and share knowledge, something you'll notice when you join us!

At New Business Access Control Solutions, we look ahead, to create innovative products and system solutions to broaden Axis's total offering. Our focus is on smart professional solutions in the area of Access Control Systems, developing products like Door Controllers, Card Readers, and related accessories. These exciting products have won the hearts of our customers and even design competitions like the Red Dot Design Award!

What does a Mechanics Designer do at the New Business Access Control Solutions department?

As a mechanical designer, you'll play a broad role, participating from the initial product idea to the global launch. Your responsibilities will include detailed mechanical design, feasibility studies, concept development, manufacturability, testing and verification, but also support in volume production and certifications.

Since product development is carried out in cross-functional project teams, you'll collaborate closely with product owners, project managers, electronics engineers, industrial designers, UX specialists, sourcing, software developers, design for manufacturing, design for testing, quality assurance, and technical writers.

You'll encounter various technologies and challenges, such as:

    Die casting
    Injection molding
    Sheet metal
    Electronics packaging
    RF/antennas
    Heat management
    User interaction methods and technologies
    Ease of use and installation
    Vandal, dust & water resistance

Our products adhere to the highest quality and performance standards because of the harsh environments they are subjected to. Therefore, you'll also design for vandal resistance, water and dust ingress protection, and corrosion prevention. As many of our products are new to us or the market, you'll have ample opportunity to utilize your creative side. To further foster innovation, we dedicate 10% of our working time to "Free Fridays," where each employee can use this time for learning, developing personal ideas, and general innovation.

Who are you?

You are a passionate product developer with a genuine interest in technology. You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in this field, with a university degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent. You master 3D modeling and mechanical design for both plastics and metal. You are used to developing complete products, from idea to volume production. You are familiar with working in teams where you take a leading role. Having experience in consumer electronics development is a significant asset.

What Axis has to offer

Axis offers a multicultural workplace with an open corporate culture. We allow and encourage our employees to think independently. From day one, you will have the opportunity to contribute with your skills in a company that believes in innovation and the individual. At Axis, you get the opportunity to build your own network for the future. Here we gather talented and creative people who all work towards the same goal - to be number one. Come join the community and contribute with your knowledge!

Your development is something we truly care about. Except from all the opportunities that come with a big organization, we encourage you to try new areas depending on your interest. For example, our concept "Axchange" where you can try new roles or responsibilities somewhere else in the company.

Axis offers great benefits, including flexible working hours, classic Swedish "fika" on Friday afternoons, morning fika every day, corporate bonus, physical training grants, insurances and your very own Axis bicycle.

Ready to Act?

Does this sound like your future adventure? Don't hesitate, send in your application today! We go through applications continuously.

If you have any questions, reach out to recruiting manager Vasilios Spiropoulos at .

Posting End Date

2026-10-18

Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action.

About Axis Communications

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.

With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.

title: Health & Safety Engineer
description:
Job Scope

High level purpose of function.

Supports the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company's health and safety management system.

Ensures compliance with applicable work environment legislation, regulations, and company requirements. Identifies, assesses, and supports the control of occupational risks through risk assessments, exposure monitoring, inspections, and incident investigations.

Supports managers and operational teams in the daily work environment and safety activities, including risk assessments, investigations, and follow-up of incidents, near misses, and risk observations.

Promotes a proactive safety culture and contributes to continuous improvement of health and safety performance.

Key Responsibilities

    Collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders across the organization to lead, coordinate, and advance systematic health and safety management and the development of a strong safety culture.
    Participates in the work of building up a Health & Safety management system in accordance with the requirements of ISO 45001 and Lyten's internal standards.
    Carry out training in health and safety.
    Compile and follow up KPI´s and report to management and other relevant parties.
    Support the organization in connection with risk assessments and other risk reviews.
    If necessary, support with investigations of incidents and accidents, with the aim of finding root causes and proposing measures to prevent it from happening again.
    Carry out investigations regarding physical work environment aspects such as exposure to chemical substances, noise, and ergonomic factors.
    Support the organization with expertise within health and safety.
    Inform, train, and coach leaders and employees in health and safety.
    Monitor and interpret changes in regulations.
    Manage or perform occupational exposure measurement.
    Manage and be superuser for existing systems regarding health and safety (TIA).
    Provide technical solutions for change management and new projects within health and safety.
    Lead or participate in health and safety related committees.
    Contacts with authorities.

Accountability/Authorization

    Budget responsibility: No
    Direct reports: No
    Manager work environment responsibility: No
    All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role.

    Degree in engineering, occupational health and safety, work environment engineering, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent qualifications demonstrated through education and professional experience.
    5+ years of work experience as a health and safety engineer, specialist or coordinator.
    Strong knowledge and experience with Swedish health and safety legislation, rules, regulations, and reporting processes.
    Good knowledge of data analysis and risk assessment methods.
    Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
    Experience in the battery manufacturing industry is a plus.
    Expertise in specific areas within health and safety, for example ergonomics, ATEX, or chemicals is a plus.

Specific skills

    Excellent English written and oral skills, Swedish is a plus.
    Highly organized and result driven.
    Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as independently.
    Has a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial spirit.
    Qualities that we cherish are flexibility, sense of quality, friendliness, motivation to take on new challenges

title: Senior Schedule Leader
description:
We are seeking an experienced & skilled Senior Schedule Leader to support a pioneering international industrial megaproject in Sweden

Role Overview

You will lead and coordinate all planning and scheduling activities within a large-scale EPC/EPCM environment, ensuring the integrity of integrated project schedules and alignment with project milestones, contractual commitments, and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities

    Develop and maintain the Scheduling Management Plan, standards, and procedures.
    Lead the preparation and control of integrated master schedules (engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning).
    Identify critical path impacts, risks, and deviations; implement mitigation and recovery plans.
    Conduct schedule risk analysis, including critical path and Monte Carlo simulations.
    Implement and enhance control methodologies such as Earned Value Management (EVM) and KPI tracking.
    Lead schedule review workshops with project teams, contractors, and the Client PMO.
    Provide clear, solution-oriented reporting to support senior management decision-making.
    Support claims management and ensure compliance with international standards and contractual frameworks.
    Mentor and guide planners, fostering a high-performance planning culture.

Profile

    10+ years of experience in project planning within large EPC/EPCM projects (mining, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, etc.).
    Experience in megaprojects (>USD 500M) with full responsibility for integrated schedules.
    Expert in Primavera P6; strong knowledge of MS Project and reporting tools (Power BI).
    Strong expertise in CPM, EVM, risk-adjusted planning, and forensic schedule analysis.
    Knowledge of PMI, AACEI, ISO 21500, FIDIC, NEC, and EPC contractual models.
    Proven leadership, decision-making ability under pressure, and experience in multicultural environments.
    Willingness to travel or relocate as required.
    Advanced English.

title: Deputy Project Control Manager
description:
The Deputy Project Control Manager supports the Project Control Manager in planning, coordinating, and overseeing all project control functions, including cost control, scheduling, progress measurement, forecasting, and reporting. The role ensures that project performance is accurately measured and communicated, enabling effective decision-making and timely corrective actions.

Acting as a key interface between engineering, procurement, construction, and finance teams, the Deputy Project Control Manager helps ensure alignment between scope, schedule, cost, and risk throughout the project lifecycle. The role may act on behalf of the Project Control Manager when required.

Key Responsibilities

Project Controls Support

    Assist in establishing and maintaining integrated project control systems covering cost, schedule, progress, and forecasting.
    Support development and maintenance of project budgets, cost breakdown structures (CBS), and work breakdown structures (WBS).
    Ensure alignment between project scope, schedule, and cost baselines.

Cost & Schedule Monitoring

    Monitor project cost and schedule performance against approved baselines.
    Support preparation of forecasts, including Estimate at Completion (EAC) and cash flow projections.
    Analyse variances and performance trends, identifying root causes and potential mitigation measures.

Reporting & Performance Analysis

    Prepare accurate and timely project control reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
    Support monthly project reviews and management reporting with reliable data and analysis.
    Ensure consistency and integrity of project control data across systems and reports.

Change & Risk Management

    Support evaluation of change requests, variations, and claims by assessing schedule and cost impacts.
    Assist in managing project contingencies and tracking risk exposure.
    Ensure approved changes are reflected in updated baselines and forecasts.

Contract & Progress Management

    Support review of contractor progress, invoices, and cost reports for accuracy and contractual compliance.
    Assist in tracking commitments, accruals, and progress measurement.
    Coordinate with planning and cost teams to ensure accurate progress reporting.

Collaboration & Governance

    Work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Planners, Cost Controllers, and Construction teams to integrate project controls into daily execution.
    Support development, implementation, and adherence to project control procedures and governance.
    Provide guidance and mentoring to junior project control staff.

Continuous Improvement

    Identify opportunities to improve project control processes, tools, and reporting practices.
    Capture and apply lessons learned to enhance future project performance.

Competencies and Experience

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
    Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in project controls, cost control, or planning roles within industrial, infrastructure, or EPC projects.
    Solid understanding of project cost control, scheduling, progress measurement, and forecasting.
    Experience with project control and planning tools (e.g., cost control systems, scheduling software).
    Good knowledge of contracts, change management, and project governance.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    Effective communication and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
    High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

You work closely with the Communications Department to organize customer events for your store

OPTIMIZE OPERATIONS AND STOCK MANAGEMENT

title: Lead Solution Architect & Consultant
description:
Lead Solution Architect \& Consultant (m/w/d)  
Was du bei uns bewegen kannst  
Pionierarbeit \& Standortscheduling: Als technische Speerspitze gestaltest du das Wachstum von inovex in der Schweiz aktiv mit. Du verbindest technologische Glaubwürdigkeit im Pre\-Sales mit nachhaltiger Projektdelivery und legst das solide Fundament, auf dem zukünftige Teams aufbauen.  
Brücke zwischen Business\-Vision \& Code: Du schliesst die Lücke zwischen Business\-Bedürfnissen und Technologie. Vage Kundenideen und komplexe Anforderungen übersetzt du treffsicher in konkrete und funktionierende Softwarelösungen.  
Hands\-on Prototyping \& Software Engineering: Der Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle liegt in der aktiven Umsetzung moderner Softwarelösungen und Systemarchitekturen direkt im Kundenprojekt. Mit hoher Geschwindigkeit baust du funktionale Prototypen sowie MVPs auf.  
Pre\-Sales \& Strategische Beratung: Du führst und/oder begleitest Kundengespräche und übersetzt Business\-Visionen in pragmatische, machbare Softwarekonzepte. Du führst interaktive Discovery\- sowie Architektur\-Workshops durch und lieferst fundierte Aufwandsschätzungen.  
Architektur\-Standards \& Agile Führung: Für unsere Projekte definierst du technische Standards sowie strukturierte Konzepte für komplexe IT\-Landschaften. Deine Projekte steuerst du nach agilen Methoden – idealerweise untermauert durch Zertifizierungen wie Professional Scrum Developer oder Scrum Master.  
Wer gut zu uns passen würde  
In der Rolle als Solution IT Architect \& Consultant liegt dein Schwerpunkt klar auf der strategischen Beratung, der vorausschauenden Konzeption und dem Aufsetzen moderner Architekturmuster – weniger auf der reinen operativen Umsetzung. Du begleitest Entscheidungsträger auf Augenhöhe, bewertest neue Technologien und legst das Fundament für zukunftsfähige Softwarelösungen. Dazu bringst du Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse aus den folgenden Bereichen mit:  
Fullstack\-Engineering \& Architektur\-Expertise: Du blickst auf mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Software\-Architekturen zurück. Dein Tech\-Stack umfasst moderne Frontend\- und Backend\-Technologien (z. B. TypeScript, Kotlin / Boot oder .NET / C\#) sowie Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD\-Pipelines.  
Cloud\-Native \& Modern Tooling: Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud\-Infrastrukturen (bevorzugt AWS oder Azure) ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du entscheidest, wann Serverless\- oder Hybrid\-Cloud\-Szenarien sinnvoll sind.  
Data \& AI Grundlagen: Ein solides Verständnis moderner Datenplattformen und Data Engineering rundet dein Profil ab, sodass du Kunden auch bei datengetriebenen Architekturen ganzheitlich beraten kannst.  
Beratungspersönlichkeit \& Unternehmergeist: Das Schliessen der Lücke zwischen Business\-Bedürfnissen und Code treibt dich an. Du denkst unternehmerisch, überzeugst Stakeholder durch fachliche Exzellenz sowie Empathie und schätzt die Abwechslung zwischen strategischem Consulting und konkretem Coding.  
Sprachkompetenz \& Reisetätigkeit: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1\), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. ösischkenntnisse sehen wir als zusätzliche Ergänzung. Eine projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft (hauptsächlich innerhalb der Schweiz, gelegentlich nach Deutschland) ist für dich kein Problem.  
Dein Team  
In Bern bauen wir gemeinsam das inovex\-Team auf. Dabei geht es nicht um die Mitarbeit in einem bestehenden Team, sondern um die aktive Mitgestaltung des Markteintritts und der Positionierung von inovex in der Schweiz. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Kernteam, das den Anspruch hat, inovex im Markt nachhaltig zu etablieren – in enger Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Deutschland. Dabei verbinden wir die Erfahrung, Methoden und technologische Exzellenz eines etablierten Unternehmens mit unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort. Unsere Konzepte implementieren wir bevorzugt mit Open Source Software im Rahmen agiler Projekte. Die meisten der von uns entwickelten Lösungen integrieren wir in bestehende IT\-Systeme, weshalb wir von Beginn unserer Projekte an auf integrierte Qualitätssicherung setzen. Bei uns verläuft kein Projekt wie das andere – je nach Kunde, Team und Technologie\-Stack ist jede Lösung einzigartig. Unser Fokus ist jedoch immer derselbe: Mit innovativen Technologien und einem hohen Anspruch an die Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme wollen wir nicht nur unsere Kunden glücklich machen, sondern auch uns selbst.

description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Gipf-Oberfrick suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Stv. Stationsleitung.

### Ihre Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Gipf-Oberfrick auf einen Blick

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Stv. Stationsleitung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Gipf-Oberfrick

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Gipf-Oberfrick liegt im malerischen Fricktal des Kantons Aargau und besticht durch seine Nähe zur Natur sowie die gute Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Straße. Sie profitieren hier von einer ruhigen, ländlichen Umgebung mit kurzen Wegen zu regionalen Wirtschaftszentren. Die Region bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort eine ausgezeichnete Lebensqualität, kombiniert mit wirtschaftlichen Chancen in einem dynamisch wachsenden Landstrich.

### Ihre Aufgaben als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Gipf-Oberfrick

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Diese Qualifikationen bringen Sie mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Stv. Stationsleitung

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Gipf-Oberfrick verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

In der Region Gipf-Oberfrick besteht aktuell eine hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen für Stationsleitungsfunktionen. Die demografische Entwicklung und Fachkräftemangel schaffen hervorragende Karrierechancen für Dipl. Pflegefachfrauen und -männer HF/FH. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit umfassendem lokalen Netzwerk, passenden Positionen und professioneller Begleitung beim erfolgreichen Jobwechsel.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Gipf-Oberfrick

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Gipf-Oberfrick

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

title: Head of Years (Up to Year 4)
description:
JOB PURPOSE
Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5-18 representing 65 nations. In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The Junior school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8.

The school wishes to appoint, for August 2027 (possibly January or April 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative, caring, and dynamic Head of Years (Up to Year 4) who will provide operational leadership, and support strategic development, for the lower junior phase up to Year 4, line manage class teachers and teaching assistants up to Year 4, and work in close partnership with the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced primary/early years specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in early childhood education, literacy and numeracy foundations, and outdoor/experiential learning. Knowledge of inquiry based learning, project based learning, or biophilic education would be preferable.

This position involves a teaching component and presents a unique opportunity to lead and nurture our youngest learners in a world-class alpine environment.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To put the students first.
To lead the day-to-day operational and educational provision for students up to Year 4, working in close partnership with and under the strategic oversight of the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To participate actively in Junior School Leadership Team meetings and contribute to strategic planning for the lower primary phase.
Direct line management of classroom teachers and teaching assistants across years up to Year 4, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and high-performing staff team.
Direct operational delivery and coordination of the Mountain School programme up to Year 4, working closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions and the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To be the primary point of contact for day-to-day academic, pastoral, and operational matters for families and day students up to Year 4.
To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.
Become involved in discipline and pastoral matters up to Year 4, ensuring student behavior aligns with school expectations.
To ensure smooth transition and induction for children entering Year 1 and progressing through to Year 4, preparing them seamlessly for upper junior years (Years 5-6).
To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the daily routine and learning environment of students up to Year 4.
To participate in staff recruitment for lower junior phase positions as required by the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To be a classroom teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 20% reduction).
To embrace innovative forms of assessment, play-based learning, and holistic reporting for young learners.

Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students

To oversee the daily pastoral care, wellbeing, and progress tracking of all students up to Year 4.
To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the Junior School DSL, Director of Junior School, and wellbeing team.
To work with the Director of Junior School, Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics and Junior School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing, and healthcare in lower primary.
To implement a nurturing and sequential Wellbeing programme across years up to Year 4 aligned with the Spirit Curriculum.
To promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion formally within the Spirit Curriculum to build a kind, positive, and inclusive culture among young learners.
To liaise with the Junior Activities Coordinator and House teams to ensure appropriate co-curricular activities, sports, and outdoor experiences for students up to Year 4.

Academic Responsibilities

To lead the daily implementation and delivery of the lower junior curriculum (up to Year 4), including the 'Wonder' projects and early literacy/numeracy frameworks.
To work closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions to plan and deliver the experiential Mountain School curriculum for students up to Year 4.
To champion sustainability, outdoor exploration, and biophilic education within the classroom and Mountain School activities.
To ensure Aiglon's Guiding Principles for learning are embedded in all teaching and learning activities for students up to Year 4.
To assist in monitoring student progress, organising learning interventions, and supporting personalised learning in coordination with the Head of Learning Support and Head of EAL.
To support the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics in teacher professional reviews and development for staff who teach up to Year 4.
To assist in overseeing internal assessments, reporting structures, and parent-teacher communication up to Year 4.
To promote and ensure effective and safe usage of school educational technology (such as Google Apps for Education and age-appropriate devices).
To participate in staff development days and continuous professional learning for the lower primary phase.
To monitor and enhance standards of teaching, learning, and classroom environment up to Year 4.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the Director of the Junior School or Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.
Embrace artificial intelligence and other related educational innovations to enhance early learning experiences.

This job outline only contains the main accountabilities relating to the post of Head of Years (Up to Year 4) and does not describe in detail all of the duties required to carry them out. The Head of Years (Up to Year 4) may be required to undertake other duties and responsibilities that are commensurate with the nature and level of the post.

title: Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics  (Up to Year 8)
description:
JOB PURPOSE
Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework.  The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5-18 representing 65 nations.  In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The Junior School is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8.

The school wishes to appoint, for August 2027 (possibly January or April 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative and dynamic Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics (Up to Year 8) who will take a whole school role in leading the educational provision of the Junior School and the inspirational ‘wonder’ curriculum for students up to Years 6 including Mountain School.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced Junior/Prep school specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in the creation and implementation of junior specific curriculum programmes. A knowledge of project based learning, inquiry based learning or biophilic education would be preferable.

This position involves a teaching component but this is a unique opportunity to introduce, develop and promote a world leading junior curriculum.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
To put the students first.
To lead the junior school and the educational provision, deputising for the Director of Junior school when required and being a key member of the Junior School Leadership Team.
To take a lead role in establishing and implementing a vision for world-class education at Aiglon.
To work with the Director of Junior School and to ensure that an Aiglon student’s education is relevant, broad, balanced and effective across all aspects of school life.
To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of Junior School and Deputy School Director (Academics) to the planning, monitoring and promotion of academic and student welfare matters.
To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.
To be fully involved in whole school strategic planning, and the implementation and development of the school’s vision for education and wellbeing.
To be a member of the extended Leadership Team, including the Academic Leadership Group.
Be involved in discipline matters and ensure students behave appropriately and in line with the school’s expectations.
To line manage and work in close partnership with the Head of Year (Up to Year 4) (who directly manages the teachers and teaching assistants in these year groups and the Mountain School for those years), maintaining oversight across curriculum implementation, pastoral care, and operational leadership for the lower junior years, as well as line managing Year 5-6 classroom teachers.
To liaise closely with Assistant Heads and Heads of Department in the senior school to ensure that the curriculum for Years 7 and 8 is exciting, dynamic, and of a high standard, effectively preparing students for IGCSE and IB programmes.
To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the school, and specifically within the provision for junior school students.
To be actively involved in staff recruitment as required by the School Director and Director of Junior School.
To be a teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 50%).
To embrace innovative forms of assessment and holistic reporting.

Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students

To lead strategic interventions for junior school students and ensure consistent tracking of student progress from an academic point of view.
To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the Director of Junior School and wellbeing team to ensure all students are supported.
To work with the Director of Junior School, Deputy School Director (Pastoral) and Junior School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing and health care.
To ensure there is a comprehensive Wellbeing curriculum that is sequential through all years up to Year 8 and links with the Years 9-13 programmes.
To work with the Deputy School Director (Pastoral) to help ensure Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are taught formally within the Spirit Curriculum to help promote a positive, kind and inclusive culture at school.
To develop service opportunities for junior students within a structured service programme.
To liaise with the Director of Junior School, Director of Character and Junior Activities Coordinator to help ensure there is a challenging co-curricular programme in place that includes activities, sports and expeditions for the junior school.

Academic Responsibilities

To manage and develop the Junior curriculum (Up to Year 8) at Aiglon.
To work closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions and the Head of Years (Up to Year 4) to plan, deliver, and oversee an experiential Mountain Curriculum spanning up to Year 6.
To champion sustainability, environmental stewardship, and biophilic education within the junior curriculum and Mountain School programme.
To ensure the Guiding Principles for learning are embedded throughout the academic side of the school as a member of the Academic Leadership Group (ALG)
To take the lead on overseeing junior cohorts and courses. Working with the Deputy School Director (Academics) to ensure standards and criteria for these courses are met and supporting the associated year groups.
To structure and organise the system of interventions associated with student data and, when appropriate, be involved in those interventions. To assist in overseeing the general provision for personalised learning.
To work with the Deputy School Director (Academics) in the preparation and implementation of policies and statements of good practice for the academic curriculum.
To work with the Deputy School Director (Academics) in the management of the teacher professional review and development process.
Together with the Deputy School Director (Academics), to oversee assessment in the school including internally set examinations and to be responsible for the school reporting and assessment structure and to monitor its delivery.
To work with the Head of Learning support and Head of EAL to ensure all learners are supported in making progress.
To analyse and disseminate data from year group CEM examinations and to oversee target setting and the administration of other measures of value-added and academic performance.
To promote and ensure effective usage of school systems such as Google Apps for Education.
Oversee staff development days across the school year in conjunction with the Director of Junior School and Deputy School Director (Academics).
To be involved in monitoring and enhancing the standards of teaching and learning throughout the school.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the School Director and Director of Junior School.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.
Embrace artificial intelligence and other related innovations in order to work towards the creation of the classroom of tomorrow.

This job outline only contains the main accountabilities relating to the post of Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics (Up to Year 8) and does not describe in detail all of the duties required to carry them out. The Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics (Up to Year 8) may be required to undertake other duties and responsibilities that are commensurate with the nature and level of the post.

- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Laufenburg suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutpsychiatrie.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Laufenburg: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutpsychiatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Laufenburg

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Laufenburg liegt im Norden des Kantons Aargau direkt an der Grenze zu Deutschland und besticht durch seine malerische Lage am Rhein. Sie profitieren von einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Bahnzugang und guter Autoanbindung via Autobahn. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Mischung aus Industrie, Mittelstand und Dienstleistungen, kombiniert mit hoher Lebensqualität und guten Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Laufenburg aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

description:
Infirmier·ère expert·e en soins intensifs  
La Clinique de La Source est un établissement de soins aigus pluridisciplinaires unique en son genre. Elle appartient à la Fondation La Source, une institution indépendante et privée à but non lucratif qui chapeaute également l'Institut et Haute École de la Santé La Source. L'indépendance que lui confère ce statut lui permet d'investir continuellement sur les plans humains et technologiques afin de garantir à ses patient·es la meilleure prise en charge possible.  
Nous recherchons un·e  
Infirmier·ère expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES à 80%  
Informations clés sur le poste :  
Référence : CLS/RH/2026\.783 / Type de contrat : Contrat à Durée Indéterminée à 80% / Horaires : en 12 heures \+ ponctuellement horaires 7h\-16h et 11h\-20h / Date d'entrée : dès que nous trouvons la bonne personne / Localisation : au cœur de Lausanne (M2 arrêt « Riponne » ou Bus 2, 3 ou 21 arrêt « Beaulieu\-Jomini »)  
Pourquoi avons\-nous besoin de vous ?  
Un membre de notre équipe poursuit aujourd'hui un nouveau projet de formation professionnel. Pour assurer la continuité d'une prise en charge d'excellence en soins intensifs, nous souhaitons accueillir un·e infirmier·ère certifié·e expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES.  
Que serez\-vous amené·e à faire ?  
Prendre en charge des patient·es présentant des situations aiguës complexes et assurer une surveillance clinique continue  
Réaliser les soins infirmiers et les actes médicaux délégués avec rigueur, en garantissant leur qualité, leur sécurité et leur traçabilité  
Surveiller attentivement l'évolution de l'état de santé des patient·es afin de prévenir et anticiper toutes complications et d'adapter la prise en charge  
Collaborer et coordonner les soins avec l'ensemble des professionnel·les impliqué·es dans la prise en charge  
Communiquer avec les patient·es et leurs proches, en leur apportant écoute, information et soutien tout au long de leur prise en charge  
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la qualité et de l'efficience des soins, en s'appuyant sur les données scientifiques et le développement des compétences  
Avec qui allez\-vous travailler ?  
L'équipe des soins intensifs, composée d'une vingtaine de soignant·es, cultive un environnement de travail technique mais serein. Sa dynamique positive repose sur le partage, la bonne humeur et la confiance mutuelle. Animée par un sens des responsabilités, elle aspire à progresser dans un milieu en constante évolution. La qualité du travail résulte d'une collaboration harmonieuse et d'une entraide quotidienne.  
Marclay, Responsable des soins intensifs et de la cardiologie, est au bénéfice d'une expérience pratique de plus de 25 ans dans le milieu de la médecine intensive. Il est défini comme une personne pragmatique dotée d'un brin d'idéalisme, prêtant une attention particulière à la collaboration, à la communication et à la confiance. Il est en constante recherche de nouvelles solutions de développement et de progression.  
Qu'attendons\-nous de vous ?  
Les indispensables :  
Etre au bénéfice d'un diplôme d'infirmier\-ère HES ou reconnu par la Croix\-Rouge Suisse  
Etre titulaire d'un diplôme d'expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES reconnu par la Société Suisse de Médecine Intensive (SGI\-SSMI)  
Avoir une expérience d'au moins trois ans en soins intensifs ou réanimation  
Etre capable de gérer son stress face aux situations d'urgence  
Posséder une aisance dans les transmissions et une excellente capacité de communication avec une expression claire et adaptée aux situations  
Vos atouts :  
Expérience et polyvalence dans différentes disciplines médicales et chirurgicales  
Sens des responsabilités et faire preuve de dynamisme, rigueur, anticipation, précision, autonomie et loyauté  
Compétences scientifiques, techniques et humaines permettant de travailler dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire  
Pourquoi choisir la Clinique de La Source ?  
Rejoindre la plus grande Clinique privée du canton de Vaud et évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, reconnu pour son expertise et son savoir\-faire  
Une unité de soins intensifs de 6 lits certifiée par la SSMI  
Profiter d'un cadre de travail à taille humaine, tout en bénéficiant de la richesse et de la diversité des activités d'une institution de santé tournée vers l'avenir  
Bénéficier de conditions d'engagement attractives et de prestations sociales avantageuses (accueil et intégration, participation LaMal, LPP avantageuse, rabais, etc.)  
Concilier vie professionnelle et vie privée, grâce à des possibilités de travail à temps partiel, jusqu'à plus de 7 semaines de vacances, des congés non payés, des jours fériés compensés et la valorisation du temps de change  
Partager des valeurs qui nous ressemblent : une clinique Unique, Respectueuse, Innovatrice et Responsable

description:
RESPONSABLE INFRASTRUCTURE \& SECURITY OFFICER (H/F)  
Depuis 1959, Bien\-Air Dental SA fait partie des leaders de l’instrumentation dentaire. À la pointe de la technologie, nous concevons, fabriquons et distribuons nos propres dispositifs et accessoires dans plus de 100 pays. L’ingéniosité, l’innovation et la qualité de nos produits et de nos services nous ont hissés en tête des marchés mondiaux. Actuellement, pour notre siège situé à Bienne, nous recherchons pour notre service « Informatique » un/e :  
RESPONSABLE INFRASTRUCTURE \& SECURITY OFFICER (H/F)  
Mission :  
Vous serez responsable de la sécurité, de l’évolution et du maintien en conditions opérationnelles de l’infrastructure informatique de l’entreprise. Par ailleurs, vous assurerez l’administration des systèmes, réseaux, solutions de sauvegarde et outils de sécurité, tout en participant activement aux projets d’évolution de notre environnement IT et au support des utilisateurs.  
Vos responsabilités :  
Administration \& maintenance infrastructure  
Assurer l’administration, la maintenance et l’évolution des infrastructures serveurs, virtualisation (VMware/Proxmox) et services Active Directory.  
Gérer les équipements réseau, la synchronisation Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync ainsi que la supervision et le monitoring des systèmes.  
Garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité de l’infrastructure tout en maintenant une documentation technique à jour.  
Administration \& maintenance Backup  
Assurer l’administration, l’optimisation et le suivi de la solution de sauvegarde Veeam Backup \& Replication.  
Garantir la protection des données en appliquant les stratégies de sauvegarde, de rétention et en réalisant des tests réguliers de restauration.  
Contribuer au PRA/PCA et maintenir une documentation complète et à jour des procédures de sauvegarde et de reprise.  
Sécurité  
Assurer l’administration et l’exploitation des solutions de sécurité, des accès et des infrastructures associées (PKI, MFA, VPN, firewalls et contrôle d’accès réseau).  
Garantir la protection des systèmes et des données en réalisant des analyses de vulnérabilités, en gérant les incidents de sécurité et en appliquant les mesures de remédiation.  
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la cybersécurité par la veille technologique, l’optimisation des solutions en place et le maintien d’un niveau de sécurité élevé.  
Projets IT  
Participer activement à des projets IT  
Collaborer avec les partenaires et fournisseurs externes  
Effectuer une veille technologique et proposer des améliorations  
Support \& gestion des incidents  
Gérer et traiter les tickets au quotidien.  
Suivre et documenter les incidents dans l’outil ITSM.  
Assurer le support utilisateurs (niveaux 2 et 3\) et résoudre les incidents.  
Votre profil  
Formation supérieure en informatique (ES, HES, Bachelor ou équivalent) ; une formation complémentaire en cybersécurité est un atout

Help our clients successfully manage global challenges
As a (Assistant) Manager in the Global Employer Services (GES) team, you will provide multi-national companies with targeted advice and strategies for running Global Mobility programs in an efficient manner. Our team supports clients with the end-to-end management of global compensation for internationally mobile employees and optimization of Tax compliance and positions. Coordinate our global tax compliance services including liaising directly with clients and Deloitte offices worldwide.

Oversee the completion of tasks and quality of the work done by junior members of the team.
Interpret and implement International Assignment Policies and ensure consistent global tax treatment of various assignment compensation items and allowances.
Advise our clients on the tax and social security implications related to various global employment issues including tax residency, avoidance of double taxation and the taxation of complex compensation such as severance payments, long term and short-term incentive income.

You have successfully completed your Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Accountancy, or Law.

You are curious to find answers, take the initiative and are happy taking on responsibility and like to work in project teams with a systematic approach.
You communicate fluently in English. Any further languages would be an advantage.

description:
Ref 2578337 \| Date: 11 Sept 2026

![Novelis Switzerland SA]( )



Novelis est animé par la volonté de façonner ensemble un monde durable.



En tant que leader mondial de produits et services innovants et le plus grand recycleur d'aluminium au monde d'aluminium, nous travaillons en partenariat avec des clients des secteurs de l'automobile, de l’aéronautique, des canettes et des spécialités pour fournir des solutions qui améliorent les avantages de l'aluminium léger.



Nous disposons d'un réseau coordonné d'opérations de laminage et de recyclage techniquement sophistiquées sur 29 sites dans 9 pays d'Amérique du Nord, d'Amérique du Sud, d'Europe et d'Asie, avec 12,750 employés dans le monde. Le siège se situe à Atlanta, aux États\-Unis.  



Nous comptons parmi nos clients certaines des marques les plus importantes et les plus connues au monde, notamment Coca\-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, et d'autres. En outre, Novelis est à la pointe de l'industrie grâce à ses efforts en matière de durabilité et de recyclage.



Participez à notre mission de créer un monde durable et commencez dès que possible à travailler sur notre site de **Sierre**, en Suisse.

**Metallurgy Modeling Scientist (m/f/d)**



Nous recherchons actuellement un ingénieur ou un chercheur hautement motivé et qualifié dans les domaines de l'ingénierie computationnelle, de la science des matériaux, de la métallurgie ou du génie mécanique pour rejoindre notre équipe sur notre site de Sierre, en Suisse.



Le développement et la production futurs d'alliages d'aluminium recyclés de haute qualité nécessitent des processus rapides et adaptatifs qui relient en temps réel le processus de fabrication et la métallurgie, ainsi qu'une prévision précise des performances.







**Vos responsabilités:**



Vous ferez partie de l’équipe chargée de poursuivre le développement de cadres de modélisation avancés en R\&D pouvant être appliqués à différentes activités à l’échelle mondiale. Cela comprend les responsabilités suivantes :



* Développer un cadre d’ingénierie computationnelle intégrée des matériaux (ICME), combinant des modèles basés sur la physique, des approches fondées sur les données et des outils numériques pour des applications à l’échelle industrielle.
* Traduire les connaissances relatives aux alliages d’aluminium, à la métallurgie, au laminage et aux procédés de finition en modèles prédictifs de microstructure et de performance permettant le développement virtuel de procédés et de produits.
* Collaborer avec les sites de production afin de garantir une adoption réussie et la concrétisation de la valeur ajoutée pour l’entreprise.


Merci de postuler avant le 2 octobre 2026\.



\-\-\-\-\-



We are currently seeking a highly motivated and skilled engineer or scientist in the field of Computational Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, or Mechanical Engineering to join our team at our Sierre location in Switzerland.



The future development and production of high\-quality recycled aluminium alloys require fast and adaptive processes that link process and metallurgy in real time, along with precise performance prediction.







**Your responsabilities:**



You will be part of the team to further develop advanced modelling frameworks in R\&D



that can be applied across different operations globally. This includes the following



responsibilities:



* Develop an Integrated Computational Materials Engineering (ICME) framework, combining physics\-based models, data\-driven approaches, and digital tools for industrial\-scale applications.
* Translate aluminium alloy, metallurgy, rolling and finishing process knowledge into predictive microstructure and performance models that enable virtual process and product development.
* Collaborate with manufacturing sites, ensuring successful adoption and business value realization.


**How to convince us:**



* Master's degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Computational Engineering, or a related field; PhD preferred.
* Strong expertise in physical metallurgy, with deep knowledge of texture evolution, recrystallization and precipitation phenomena
* Experience with computational materials engineering approaches and modelling tools such as VPSC, DAMASK, CP\-FEM
* Proficiency in scientific programming and data analysis ( Python, MATLAB or similar).
* Ability to bridge the gap between advanced materials science and industrial application by communicating complex technical concepts clearly across all organizational levels.
* Fluent in English; French is an advantage.
* Demonstrated innovation mindset, curiosity and passion for continuous learning, with a self\-driven, highly autonomous and result\-oriented working style.






Please apply before 2nd October, 2026\.

title: Applied Physicist/Engineer - ATLAS ITk at CERN
description:
What you'll do:
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the final integration of the ITk detector prior to installation in the experiment is a crucial step to validate the full functionality.

As an applied physicist or engineer in the CERN-ATL Team, you will join the Tracker section (EP-ATL-TRK) and work closely with personnel from the Detector Technologies Group (EP-DT) on the construction and integration of the ATLAS ITk Pixel System and its integration into the ATLAS ITk.

Your responsibilities:
- Reception testing of ITk Silicon Pixel Detector elements and testing of multi-module Pixel structures to be integrated into the ITk Pixel Outer Barrel.

- Testing and verification of integrated ITk Pixel Detector structures and services as well as combined testing with the ITk Strip Detector in the surface integration facility (SR1) at CERN.

- Deploy and improve software and hardware elements for integration testing and service validation (online, detector control, detector safety) for the Pixel Detector and the combined ITk.

- Document procedures and results for ITk integration testing and service validation and develop testing procedures for the ITk Detector after installation.

- Participate hands-on in the ITk Detector integration work in the surface cleanroom as well as the preparation of equipment for the different testing stages.

Your profile:
- Proven experience in the construction and integration of silicon pixel detectors for high energy physics experiments.

- Proven experience in the testing and data analysis of silicon detector systems.

- Proven experience in silicon detector operation and quality control including the development, installation and commissioning of laboratory infrastructure.

- Experience in the development of DAQ/online software or detector control systems for silicon detector testing and operation.

- Demonstrated experience in working in a multi-disciplinary team and international collaboration, including physicists, engineers and technicians involved in work on detector construction.

- Experience on interpreting CAD designs of mechanics components or cooling plant operation is advantageous.

- Experience with the assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment is advantageous.

- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physicist or Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.

- Assembly and integration of detectors.

- Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.

- Development of application software.

- Assembly and integration of infrastructure for detectors or experimental facilities.

- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.

- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

- Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.

- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.

- Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.

- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
A valid driving licence.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Contract duration (in months): 48

30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

title: Applied Physicist/Engineer - ATLAS ITk Integration
description:
What you'll do:
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction and integration of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). The different parts of the ITk system are being constructed and integrated in institutes and then transported to CERN where the entire ITk will be assembled.

As an applied physicist or engineer in the CERN-ATL Team, you will join the Tracker section (EP-ATL-TRK) and work closely with the teams in the different institutes to synchronise the integration testing of the ATLAS ITk parts on surface, support their integration and commissioning into the ATLAS ITk and prepare the cavern commissioning.

Your responsibilities:
- Testing and verification of integrated ITk Strip Barrel and Endcap structures and services in the surface integration facility (SR1) at CERN.
- Work closely with integration sites off CERN, e.g. DESY or NIKHEF, synchronise the testing and provide trouble shooting support for integration teams including support at the sites.
- Develop software and hardware elements for the integration testing of ITk Barrel and Endcaps in the various integration sites and validate the procedures in SR1.
- Streamline and document procedures for ITk integration testing and service validation and extend the testing procedures for the ITk Detector after installation and during commissioning.
- Participate hands-on in the ITk Detector integration work in the ATLAS SR1 cleanroom and during ITk installation in the cavern including the preparation of equipment in the cavern.

Your profile:
- Proven experience in the integration, testing and operation of silicon detectors for high energy physics experiments.
- Proven experience in integration and commissioning of silicon trackers including services validation.
- Demonstrated experience in the development of DAQ/online software or detector control systems for silicon detectors in high energy physics experiments.
- Demonstrated experience in developing and streamlining testing procedures.
- Demonstrated experience in integration and commissioning of silicon trackers including services validation.
- Previous work on particle detector operation in an experiment is advantageous.
- Experience with the assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment is advantageous.
- Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physicist or Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.
- Assembly and integration of detectors.
- Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.
- Development of application software.
- Assembly and integration of infrastructure for detectors or experimental facilities.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

- Einhaltung der geltenden Hygienevorschriften und Lebensmittelgesetze

**Mit folgenden Eigenschaften überzeugen Sie uns:**

- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie als Koch/Köchin mit anschliessender einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hygiene, HACCP sowie Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards; entsprechende Hygieneschulungen von Vorteil

- Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

- Gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch, weitere Sprachen wie Englisch und Französisch sind von Vorteil

**Wir bieten:**

- Ein dynamisches und motiviertes Team, das viel Freude an den Aufgaben hat
- Ein lebendiges Umfeld in einem der führenden Häuser der Schweizer Luxushotellerie

- Mitarbeiter- sowie Family & Friends-Vorteile im Les Trois Rois
- Tolle Vergünstigungen z.B. 30% in der hoteleigenen Blumenboutique Fleurs des Rois
- Europa Park-Vergünstigungen
- Zentraler Arbeitsort direkt in der Basler Altstadt
- Neu eröffnetes Mitarbeiterrestaurant mit Blick auf den Rhein

Möchten Sie Teil dieses motivierten Teams werden? Dann bewerben Sie sich noch heute. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

**Willkommen im Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois!**

Das Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois in Basel zählt mit seiner fast 350-jährigen Geschichte zu den traditionsreichsten Hotels Europas. Direkt am Rhein und im Herzen der Basler Altstadt gelegen, vereint es historischen Charme mit zeitloser Eleganz. Unter dem Motto «Rich in History, Young at Heart» verfolgt das Haus das Ziel, höchste Ansprüche zu erfüllen und seinen Gästen unvergessliche Erlebnisse zu bereiten. In 82 stilvoll ausgestatteten Zimmern und Suiten geniessen die Gäste exklusiven Komfort und gelebte Gastfreundschaft.

Kulinarisch überzeugt das Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois mit einem vielseitigen Angebot: dem Gourmet-Restaurant Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl, ausgezeichnet mit drei Michelin-Sternen, 19 GaultMillau-Punkten und 2025 von La Liste auf Platz 1 der weltbesten Restaurants geführt, der Brasserie Les Trois Rois mit 15 GaultMillau-Punkten sowie einer eleganten Bar mit preisgekrönten Cocktails.

Ein neues Kapitel der Hotelgeschichte wurde mit dem von Herzog & de Meuron umgebauten Kopfgebäude aufgeschlagen. Entstanden sind neue Zimmer und Suiten, wandelbare Eventräume, das Restaurant Banks – Basels neuer Treffpunkt mit europäisch-asiatischer Küche und Sharing-Konzept – sowie der japanisch inspirierte Wellbeing-Bereich Seijaku, eine Oase der Ruhe inmitten der Stadt.

Senior Public Sector Developer (w/m/d)
======================================

Als zentrale Ansprechperson bündeln sich bei dir alle wesentlichen Public Sector Themen und du fungierst als verbindendes Element zwischen der Public Sector Division und den Bechtle Vertriebseinheiten in der Schweiz.

* Du orchestrierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Herstellern, Bechtle Gesellschaften nach dem Prinzip OneBechtle.

**Deine Skills? Mehr als interessant:**

* Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.




**Du verdienst echten Mehrwert. Freu dich deshalb auf:**

* Weiterentwicklung: Mit einem umfangreichen Angebot der Bechtle Akademie, individueller Karriereplanung und weiteren Entwicklungsprogrammen kannst du dich fachlich sowie persönlich entwickeln

* Flexibilität: Deine Arbeitszeit und deinen Arbeitsort kannst du je nach Aufgabengebiet und in Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft individuell gestalten

La Clinique de La Source est un établissement de soins aigus pluridisciplinaires unique en son genre. L’indépendance que lui confère ce statut lui permet d’investir continuellement sur les plans humains et technologiques afin de garantir à ses patient·es la meilleure prise en charge possible.

Infirmier·ère expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES à 80%

Référence : CLS/RH/ / Type de contrat : Contrat à Durée Indéterminée à 80% / Horaires : en 12 heures \+ ponctuellement horaires 7h\-16h et 11h\-20h / Date d’entrée : dès que nous trouvons la bonne personne / Localisation : au cœur de Lausanne (M2 arrêt « Riponne » ou Bus 2, 3 ou 21 arrêt « Beaulieu\-Jomini »)  
Pourquoi avons\-nous besoin de vous ?  
Un membre de notre équipe poursuit aujourd’hui un nouveau projet de formation professionnel. Pour assurer la continuité d’une prise en charge d’excellence en soins intensifs, nous souhaitons accueillir un·e infirmier·ère certifié·e expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES.  
Que serez\-vous amené·e à faire ?  
Prendre en charge des patient·es présentant des situations aiguës complexes et assurer une surveillance clinique continue  
Réaliser les soins infirmiers et les actes médicaux délégués avec rigueur, en garantissant leur qualité, leur sécurité et leur traçabilité

Communiquer avec les patient·es et leurs proches, en leur apportant écoute, information et soutien tout au long de leur prise en charge  
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la qualité et de l’efficience des soins, en s’appuyant sur les données scientifiques et le développement des compétences  
Avec qui allez\-vous travailler ?  
L’équipe des soins intensifs, composée d'une vingtaine de soignant·es, cultive un environnement de travail technique mais serein. Il est défini comme une personne pragmatique dotée d’un brin d’idéalisme, prêtant une attention particulière à la collaboration, à la communication et à la confiance. Il est en constante recherche de nouvelles solutions de développement et de progression.  
Qu’attendons\-nous de vous ?  
Les indispensables :  
Etre au bénéfice d’un diplôme d’infirmier\-ère HES ou reconnu par la Croix\-Rouge Suisse  
Etre titulaire d'un diplôme d’expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES reconnu par la Société Suisse de Médecine Intensive (SGI\-SSMI)  
Avoir une expérience d’au moins trois ans en soins intensifs ou réanimation  
Etre capable de gérer son stress face aux situations d'urgence  
Posséder une aisance dans les transmissions et une excellente capacité de communication avec une expression claire et adaptée aux situations  
Vos atouts :  
Expérience et polyvalence dans différentes disciplines médicales et chirurgicales  
Sens des responsabilités et faire preuve de dynamisme, rigueur, anticipation, précision, autonomie et loyauté  
Compétences scientifiques, techniques et humaines permettant de travailler dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire  
Pourquoi choisir la Clinique de La Source ?  
Rejoindre la plus grande Clinique privée du canton de Vaud et évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, reconnu pour son expertise et son savoir\-faire

Bénéficier de conditions d’engagement attractives et de prestations sociales avantageuses (accueil et intégration, participation LaMal, LPP avantageuse, rabais, etc.)  
Concilier vie professionnelle et vie privée, grâce à des possibilités de travail à temps partiel, jusqu’à plus de 7 semaines de vacances, des congés non payés, des jours fériés compensés et la valorisation du temps de change

title: Applied Physicist/Engineer - ATLAS ITk Integration
description:
What you'll do:
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction and integration of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). The different parts of the ITk system are being constructed and integrated in institutes and then transported to CERN where the entire ITk will be assembled.

As an applied physicist or engineer in the CERN-ATL Team, you will join the Tracker section (EP-ATL-TRK) and work closely with the teams in the different institutes to synchronise the integration testing of the ATLAS ITk parts on surface, support their integration and commissioning into the ATLAS ITk and prepare the cavern commissioning.

Your responsibilities:
- Testing and verification of integrated ITk Strip Barrel and Endcap structures and services in the surface integration facility (SR1) at CERN.
- Work closely with integration sites off CERN, e.g. DESY or NIKHEF, synchronise the testing and provide trouble shooting support for integration teams including support at the sites.
- Develop software and hardware elements for the integration testing of ITk Barrel and Endcaps in the various integration sites and validate the procedures in SR1.
- Streamline and document procedures for ITk integration testing and service validation and extend the testing procedures for the ITk Detector after installation and during commissioning.
- Participate hands-on in the ITk Detector integration work in the ATLAS SR1 cleanroom and during ITk installation in the cavern including the preparation of equipment in the cavern.

Your profile:
- Proven experience in the integration, testing and operation of silicon detectors for high energy physics experiments.
- Proven experience in integration and commissioning of silicon trackers including services validation.
- Demonstrated experience in the development of DAQ/online software or detector control systems for silicon detectors in high energy physics experiments.
- Demonstrated experience in developing and streamlining testing procedures.
- Demonstrated experience in integration and commissioning of silicon trackers including services validation.
- Previous work on particle detector operation in an experiment is advantageous.
- Experience with the assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment is advantageous.
- Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physicist or Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.
- Assembly and integration of detectors.
- Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.
- Development of application software.
- Assembly and integration of infrastructure for detectors or experimental facilities.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:

- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

title: Head of Years (Up to Year 4)
description:
JOB PURPOSE
Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5-18 representing 65 nations. In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The Junior school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8.

The school wishes to appoint, for August 2027 (possibly January or April 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative, caring, and dynamic Head of Years (Up to Year 4) who will provide operational leadership, and support strategic development, for the lower junior phase up to Year 4, line manage class teachers and teaching assistants up to Year 4, and work in close partnership with the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced primary/early years specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in early childhood education, literacy and numeracy foundations, and outdoor/experiential learning. Knowledge of inquiry based learning, project based learning, or biophilic education would be preferable.

This position involves a teaching component and presents a unique opportunity to lead and nurture our youngest learners in a world-class alpine environment.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To put the students first.
To lead the day-to-day operational and educational provision for students up to Year 4, working in close partnership with and under the strategic oversight of the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To participate actively in Junior School Leadership Team meetings and contribute to strategic planning for the lower primary phase.
Direct line management of classroom teachers and teaching assistants across years up to Year 4, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and high-performing staff team.
Direct operational delivery and coordination of the Mountain School programme up to Year 4, working closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions and the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To be the primary point of contact for day-to-day academic, pastoral, and operational matters for families and day students up to Year 4.
To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.
Become involved in discipline and pastoral matters up to Year 4, ensuring student behavior aligns with school expectations.
To ensure smooth transition and induction for children entering Year 1 and progressing through to Year 4, preparing them seamlessly for upper junior years (Years 5-6).
To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the daily routine and learning environment of students up to Year 4.
To participate in staff recruitment for lower junior phase positions as required by the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To be a classroom teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 20% reduction).
To embrace innovative forms of assessment, play-based learning, and holistic reporting for young learners.

Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students

To oversee the daily pastoral care, wellbeing, and progress tracking of all students up to Year 4.
To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the Junior School DSL, Director of Junior School, and wellbeing team.
To work with the Director of Junior School, Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics and Junior School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing, and healthcare in lower primary.
To implement a nurturing and sequential Wellbeing programme across years up to Year 4 aligned with the Spirit Curriculum.
To promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion formally within the Spirit Curriculum to build a kind, positive, and inclusive culture among young learners.
To liaise with the Junior Activities Coordinator and House teams to ensure appropriate co-curricular activities, sports, and outdoor experiences for students up to Year 4.

Academic Responsibilities

To lead the daily implementation and delivery of the lower junior curriculum (up to Year 4), including the 'Wonder' projects and early literacy/numeracy frameworks.
To work closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions to plan and deliver the experiential Mountain School curriculum for students up to Year 4.
To champion sustainability, outdoor exploration, and biophilic education within the classroom and Mountain School activities.
To ensure Aiglon's Guiding Principles for learning are embedded in all teaching and learning activities for students up to Year 4.
To assist in monitoring student progress, organising learning interventions, and supporting personalised learning in coordination with the Head of Learning Support and Head of EAL.
To support the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics in teacher professional reviews and development for staff who teach up to Year 4.
To assist in overseeing internal assessments, reporting structures, and parent-teacher communication up to Year 4.
To promote and ensure effective and safe usage of school educational technology (such as Google Apps for Education and age-appropriate devices).
To participate in staff development days and continuous professional learning for the lower primary phase.
To monitor and enhance standards of teaching, learning, and classroom environment up to Year 4.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the Director of the Junior School or Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.
Embrace artificial intelligence and other related educational innovations to enhance early learning experiences.

This job outline only contains the main accountabilities relating to the post of Head of Years (Up to Year 4) and does not describe in detail all of the duties required to carry them out. The Head of Years (Up to Year 4) may be required to undertake other duties and responsibilities that are commensurate with the nature and level of the post.
