**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als « Chief of Staff».**




**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung



**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- z.B. via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst



**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit den beiden Eigentümern und Co\-CEOs von Consult \& Pepper zusammen und erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie ein KMU geführt und weiterentwickelt wird.**  
**Du wirst dabei nicht nur an konzeptionellen und strategischen Themen arbeiten. Zu einem KMU gehören genauso administrative Aufgaben und ganz pragmatische Probleme, die gelöst werden müssen. Genau diese Mischung macht die aus.**

**Möchtest du Unternehmertum nicht nur aus dem Studium kennen, sondern im Alltag erleben und mitgestalten?**

Dann freuen sich  **und Saia** über deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder deinen Anruf (\+ ).

About This Role: As the Global Commercial Lead Dravet, you will be at the forefront of our global commercialization strategy. You will be responsible for leading the Global Marketing team, driving the development of campaigns, messages, omni-channel content, and marketing tactics. Your immediate focus will be to optimize short-term brand plans for revenue maximization, ensuring support for hitting annual revenue targets. In this dynamic role, you will also provide critical commercial insights for long-term strategic decisions, including lifecycle management. By owning the target product profile throughout the lifecycle, you'll ensure asset value maximization through launch and beyond. Partnering with regional teams and G10 affiliates will be crucial to forecasting and identifying business opportunities. You will also lead external stakeholder engagement and contribute to franchise strategy, driving cross-functional alignment and operating within a Product Development & Commercialization model.


What You’ll Do:

- Own and implement short-term brand plans with a focus on immediate revenue targets.
- Lead the Global Marketing team in developing campaigns, messages, and omni-channel content.
- Provide commercial input into long-term strategic decisions, such as lifecycle management and indication expansion.
- Maintain ownership of the target product profile throughout its lifecycle.

- Partner with regional teams and G10 affiliates to forecast and identify business opportunities.
- Lead competitive intelligence and market leadership efforts.

- Plan and execute launch readiness and execution where relevant.
- Drive cross-functional alignment and lead teams in a matrix environment.

Who You Are: You are an accomplished leader with a strategic mindset and a passion for driving commercial success. You excel in developing and executing complex strategies that span both short-term and long-term objectives. You thrive in dynamic settings and are skilled at engaging external stakeholders to maximize asset value. Your experience in global markets, particularly in rare, neuro, and immuno areas, equips you to drive innovation and revenue growth.


Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree required (in a relevant field such as business, life sciences, or related discipline).

Required Skills:
- At least 15 years of experience in pharma/biotech.

- P&L experience strongly preferred.

- 5 years of ex-US experience strongly preferred.
- Strong leadership in cross-functional alignment and matrix environments.
- Expertise in external stakeholder engagement and competitive intelligence.

/Graduate Accountant
====================

**KandouAI** is redefining AI infrastructure through innovative interconnect technologies that significantly reduce power consumption while maintaining high bandwidth and ultra\-low latency. Our mission is to make AI systems more scalable, efficient, and accessible.

**For our Headquarter in Saint\-Sulpice, we are actively looking for a /Graduate Accountant.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join the Finance team as a /Graduate Accountant. This is an entry\-level role, ideal for someone early in their career who wants hands\-on exposure to day\-to\-day accounting and finance operations. This is a global role: you will support transactions, postings, and reconciliations across Kandou's multiple legal entities and countries (including Switzerland, the US, UK, Germany, , and Taiwan), not just the Swiss entity — so exposure to multi\-currency and multi\-entity accounting is part of the job. You will be a key member of a small Finance team, gradually building toward full ownership of core bookkeeping tasks as you grow in the role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support processing of vendor payments and transactions across multiple Kandou entities/countries (e.g., invoice entry, payment runs, matching to purchase orders)
* Assist with posting journal entries and routine general ledger transactions
* Help prepare monthly bank, vendor, and account reconciliations, flagging and following up on discrepancies
* Support the AP/AR cycle, including invoice coding, approvals tracking, and vendor queries
* Assist with the monthly close process under supervision (accruals, prepayments, basic schedules)
* Help maintain accurate, organized supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes
* Support ad hoc finance projects and administrative tasks as assigned by the team
* Supporting the team in the implementation of AI across finance operations


**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field


**Required Experience**

* No prior professional experience required; internships or academic projects in accounting/finance are a plus
* familiarity with accounting principles (debits/credits, journal entries, basic reconciliations)


**Required Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers
* working knowledge of Excel
* Eagerness to learn accounting systems and tools (e.g., Microsoft Business Central or similar ERP — training will be provided)
* Eagerness to support AI implementation in finance (e.g., agents or AI\-assisted workflows)
* Organized, able to manage multiple small tasks and deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable asking questions and escalating issues
* Team player with a proactive, can\-do attitude


**What We Offer**

* Direct mentorship from experienced accounting and finance professionals
* Hands\-on exposure to the full transaction\-to\-reporting cycle at a fast\-growing, global semiconductor company
* Hybrid working model


If you recognize yourself in the description above, and love to be part of a growing Company, are a good team player with an upbeat approach to life, we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!

**Please submit your application through our website:**

INSTITUTIONAL SALES ASSOCIATE (Geneva, Lausanne or Zurich)
==========================================================

Description de l'entreprise
---------------------------

**Location:** Geneva, Lausanne, or Zurich (Hybrid)


**The Company**

A Swiss\-headquartered, FINMA\-regulated securities firm at the forefront of digital asset trading and financial services. The company provides institutional\-grade infrastructure covering custody, tokenization, trading, staking, and derivatives for banks, corporates, hedge funds, family offices, and blockchain foundations.

With \~100 employees and a rapidly growing international footprint, the company is expanding its Swiss sales team.

Description du poste
--------------------

**The Role**

As Institutional Sales Associate, you will play a key role in prospecting, qualifying leads, and supporting the full sales cycle. This is a client\-facing position with significant exposure to senior team members and institutional clients.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct targeted research to identify high\-potential prospects (institutions, corporates, hedge funds, family offices, blockchain foundations, issuers)
* Initiate outbound outreach via email, calls, and social channels to qualify leads within the Swiss market
* Own all phases of the sales cycle: prepare tailored presentations, proposals, and client\-facing materials
* Schedule and coordinate client meetings; manage follow\-ups and pipeline communication
* Develop deep product knowledge across the full suite (custody, tokenization, trading, staking, derivatives)
* Maintain accurate CRM records (Salesforce) and support reporting/forecasting
* Foster ongoing client relationships; identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities
* Stay informed on crypto industry trends, competitors, and regulatory developments
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Marketing, Legal, and Operations teams
* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to the sales process

Profil recherché
-----------------

**Your Profile**

* 2\-5 years of experience in sales, business development, or client\-facing roles within financial services, fintech, or digital assets
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or related field
* Strong understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the digital asset ecosystem
* Excellent communication skills; ability to simplify complex technical concepts
* Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce) to track pipeline and client interactions
* High attention to detail; ability to manage multiple prospects and prioritize effectively
* Fluent in English; French or German is a strong advantage
* Professional, responsive, customer\-centric mindset

**Important:** This role involves significant cold outreach \- they're building from scratch. Candidates must have existing contacts in banks/institutions with crypto interest. Pure advisory or market analyst profiles without direct sales experience are not a fit.


**The Offer**

* Base salary \+ performance\-based variable
* Hybrid work model with flexibility
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and institutional clients
* Fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with real growth opportunities
* Work at the intersection of finance and blockchain technology

title: Legal Advisor - Commodities Trade Finance + Wealth Management
description:
Description de l'entreprise


**Client:**

Our client is an established Swiss financial institution with an international client base and activities spanning Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management and Treasury. The Bank is looking for a pragmatic, commercially\-minded Legal Advisor to join its Legal \& Compliance function and provide hands\-on legal support across the business. A bank that Finders know well, thus able to explain the culture and working environment to any potentially, suitable applicant.

Description du poste

**Position:**

Reporting to the Head of Legal \& Compliance, you will provide day\-to\-day legal advice across the Bank, helping the business navigate legal and regulatory matters while taking a practical and solutions\-focused approach. You will work closely with colleagues across the business, particularly Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management, Financial Institutions and Compliance, and will also liaise with clients, external counsel and Swiss authorities where required.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide legal advice and practical guidance to the Bank's various departments on Swiss and international legal matters.
* Draft, review and negotiate banking agreements, security documentation and other legal documents, particularly in relation to Commodity Trade Finance and Wealth Management.
* Support the Bank on legal matters involving clients, counterparties, authorities, courts and bankruptcy offices.
* Advise on client succession and estate\-related matters.
* Review internal policies, directives and standard documentation and ensure they remain aligned with applicable legislation.
* Monitor developments in Swiss banking legislation and regulation and advise the Head of Legal \& Compliance on their impact on the Bank.
* Work with Compliance on cross\-functional legal and regulatory matters.
* Coordinate external lawyers on specialist advice, disputes and litigation where required.
* Conduct legal research and prepare opinions, reports and other legal documentation.
* Provide legal and regulatory training to colleagues where appropriate.
* Act as a deputy to the Head of Legal \& Compliance on legal matters when required.

**Why Apply?**


A good opportunity for a Swiss\-qualified lawyer looking for a varied in\-house position within a specialist banking environment, rather than a narrowly defined legal role. You will have genuine exposure to the business, including Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management and Financial Institutions, within an international and multicultural organisation. The role offers considerable variety and the opportunity to take ownership of matters while working closely with experienced colleagues and senior stakeholders.

Profil recherché

**Profile:**

* Swiss\-qualified lawyer, ideally with Brevet d'avocat
* Proven experience in Swiss banking law
* Commodity Trade Finance experience is essential
* Good understanding of Swiss banking regulations and related regulatory/compliance matters
* Strong legal drafting, research and analytical skills
* Experience reviewing and negotiating commercial and banking documentation
* Pragmatic, commercially\-minded approach with sound judgement
* Well organised and able to manage multiple matters and deadlines
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Fluent written and spoken French and English
* Swiss resident

description:
Bei Belimo sind wir stolz darauf, unser Unternehmen zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort zu machen. Unsere Führungskräfte sind werteorientiert und fördern neue Ideen in ihren Teams auf der ganzen Welt. Mit ihrer Leidenschaft stellen unsere Mitarbeiter nicht nur beeindruckende Produkte her, sondern revolutionieren auch die HLK\-Branche. Investitionen in unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Fundament des Unternehmens Belimo, um diverse kreative Talente zu gewinnen und ein branchenführendes Unternehmen zu schaffen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement eines jeden Einzelnen.

Teamleitung IT Support \& IT Service Management (80\-100%)

Einführung

Deine Chance, das IT Service Management von Belimo weltweit mitzugestalten.

Der Service Desk ist für unsere Mitarbeitenden die Visitenkarte der IT. Wie gut er funktioniert, prägt das Vertrauen in die ganze IT\-Organisation.

Als Teamleiter oder Teamleiterin IT Support \& IT Service Management führst du das Support\-Team in Hinwil und gestaltest die globale IT\-Support\- und IT\-Service\-Management\-Organisation aktiv mit. Gemeinsam mit unserem internationalen IT\-Hub entwickelst du einheitliche Standards und Prozesse weiter und sorgst für hohe Servicequalität sowie einen effizienten Support, auf den sich Mitarbeitende weltweit verlassen können.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

* In dieser Rolle führst und entwickelst du ein engagiertes Support\-Team von etwa zehn Mitarbeitenden (inkl. Lernenden und Werkstudenten), stärkst eine serviceorientierte, kollegiale Teamkultur und sorgst gemeinsam mit deinem Team dafür, dass der 1st\- und 2nd\-Level\-Support professionell gewährleistet wird.
* Du treibst die Definition und Standardisierung von ITSM\-Prozessen nach ITIL voran \- über den gesamten Lifecycle von Incident\- und Problem\- bis Change\- und Request\-Management \- und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit dem IT\-Hub
* Du unterstützt den Aufbau eines aussagekräftigen KPI\-, SLA\- und Customer\-Satisfaction\-Reportings, leitest ein Service Management Meeting und ergreifst gezielte Massnahmen zur Verbesserung von Servicequalität und operativer Effizienz, um die operativen Ziele zu erreichen.
* Die Steuerung und Mitwirkung bei kritischen Incidents und Eskalationen gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich \- auch unter Druck behältst du den Überblick.
* Self\-Service, Automatisierung und Knowledge Management treibst du aktiv voran und sorgst dafür, dass Prozesse dokumentiert und regelmässig überprüft werden.
* Du arbeitest eng mit Key Usern, Fachbereichen und den Teams aus Infrastructure, IT Security, Digital Workplace und Application Management zusammen, steuerst externe Service Provider und Technologiepartner und unterstützt bei Audits und Compliance\-Anforderungen.


Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

* Du verfügst über fundierte IT\-Erfahrung mit Fokus auf Service Management und IT Support und hast bereits Verantwortung für die Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen übernommen.
* Du bringst Führungserfahrung mit und die Fähigkeit, Mitarbeitende zu entwickeln, zu motivieren und eine positive Teamkultur zu schaffen.
* Die Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld ist dir vertraut \- du hast Prozesse über Länder\- und Standortgrenzen hinweg abgestimmt, auch ohne direkte Weisungsbefugnis.
* Du hast KPIs und SLAs selbst definiert, gemessen und daraus konkrete Verbesserungen abgeleitet.
* Ein solides Verständnis von IT\-Infrastruktur, Microsoft 365 und Digital\-Workplace\-Umgebungen bringst du mit, ebenso Erfahrung mit Service\-Management\- und Ticketing\-Plattformen.
* Dein Profil wird abgerundet durch eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Richtung. Eine ITIL\-Weiterbildung ist von Vorteil.
* Du bist serviceorientiert, strukturiert und kommunikativ \- und bewahrst auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.
* Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch und bist bereit, gelegentlich zu reisen.


Was dich bei uns erwartet

Bei uns kannst du global Wirkung erzielen und gleichzeitig nah an den Menschen und am operativen Geschäft bleiben. Du arbeitest mit einem Team, das gemeinsam etwas bewegen, Verantwortung übernehmen und sich weiterentwickeln möchte. Dabei verbindest du Führung mit strategischem Denken und einer ausgeprägten Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft \- mit viel Raum, das IT Service Management aktiv zu gestalten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Regelung von Heizungs\-, Lüftungs\- und Klimaanlagen. Klappenantriebe, Regelventile, Sensoren und Zähler bilden dabei unser Kerngeschäft. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Schweizer Börse (SIX) kotiert.

Head of Information Systems
===========================

Description de l'entreprise
---------------------------

Our client, an international company active in physical petroleum products trading and shipping, is looking for its Head of Information Systems for its Geneva office.

Description du poste
--------------------

Reporting to the General Manager, you define and deliver the information systems strategy supporting the full trade lifecycle, from front to back. You are the key point of contact for all information systems matters in Geneva and a trusted business partner to senior management.


**Your responsibilities**

Information systems strategy and governance

* Define, maintain and execute the information systems roadmap, aligned with the business objectives of the Geneva office and the group
* Establish governance, policies and procedures, and prioritise the project portfolio with business stakeholders
* Prepare, manage and monitor the capital and operating budgets for information technology


Trading platform ownership

* Act as owner of the energy trading and risk management platform: implementation, evolution, upgrades and integration with market data, accounting and reporting systems
* Translate business requirements from Trading, Operations, Risk, Middle Office, Finance and Accounting into functional specifications
* Coordinate configuration, user acceptance testing and go\-live, and ensure data quality and system stability


Infrastructure and operations

* Oversee the Microsoft environment (Active Directory, Microsoft 365, servers, network, end\-user devices) with the team and external providers
* Ensure high availability, backup, business continuity and disaster recovery of all critical systems
* Supervise user support in line with agreed service levels


Team leadership

* Lead, coach and develop a small information technology team
* Set objectives and priorities, and balance the workload across the team


Security and compliance

* Define and enforce security policies, access management and user awareness, in coordination with group information technology
* Identify and mitigate technology risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory, audit and data protection requirements


Vendor management

* Select, negotiate with and manage software vendors, integrators and service providers, including market data vendors
* Monitor contracts, licences, service levels and costs

* Good knowledge of Microsoft\-based infrastructure, application integration, information security and compliance in a trading environment
* Experience managing vendors and technology roadmaps; knowledge of artificial intelligence use cases and governance is a plus
* A hands\-on leader, able to drive strategy while staying close to operations and to the team
* Fluent English is mandatory; French is a strong plus

Manager, Accounting \& Finance
==============================

An established international service\-based organization is seeking an experienced **Manager, Accounting \& Finance** to lead the finance operations of its European regional business. The organization operates globally, bringing together professionals, industry leaders, regulators, and stakeholders to advance innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional excellence in highly regulated sectors.

This is a unique opportunity for a strategic and hands\-on finance leader to serve as a key member of the regional leadership team while partnering closely with global finance and European regional operations. The successful candidate will oversee all accounting, treasury, financial planning, and financial analysis activities across the European region and play an integral role in supporting organizational growth and operational excellence.

Only candidates currently residing within commuting distance of Basel, Switzerland will be considered for this role.

**Position Summary**

Supporting regional and global leadership, the **Manager, Accounting \& Finance** will be responsible for the financial stewardship of the European region. This role combines strategic financial planning with operational accounting leadership and requires a strong understanding of cross\-border business operations, international accounting standards, treasury management, and regulatory \& tax compliance.

The successful candidate will provide financial insight, business partnership, and operational leadership to support both regional and global objectives.



**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Leadership \& Business Partnership**

* Serve as the primary finance partner to regional leadership.
* Provide recommendations regarding financial performance, risk management, and long\-term business sustainability.
* Support regional strategy development through financial modeling, business case analysis, and evaluation of new opportunities.
* Participate actively as a member of the European regional leadership team.


**Accounting \& Financial Operations**

* Lead and manage all regional accounting activities, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements and internal policies.
* Oversee general ledger activities, month\-end and year\-end close processes, and financial reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate preparation of management reports and financial analyses.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to maintain consistency in accounting and reporting practices.


**Treasury, Accounts Receivable \& Accounts Payable**

* Manage banking relationships and regional cash management activities.
* Oversee accounts receivable and accounts payable functions.
* Monitor cash flow and working capital requirements.
* Support treasury planning and financial risk management activities across the region.


**Budgeting, Forecasting \& Financial Analysis**

* Lead the annual budgeting process and ongoing forecasting activities.
* Develop monthly financial forecasts and cash flow projections.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and develop corrective action plans in collaboration with regional leaders.
* Prepare ad\-hoc and insightful profitability, cost\-benefit, and break\-even analyses to support strategic decision\-making.


**Compliance, Audit \& Risk Management**

* Maintain compliance with relevant accounting, tax, VAT, and regulatory requirements throughout as it pertains to the organization’s operations.
* Monitor changes in financial and tax legislation and implement necessary process updates.
* Support annual external audits and coordinate with auditors as required.
* Review contracts alongside local leadership and external legal advisors to minimize risk exposure and ensure compliance.


**People \& Vendor Management**

* Oversee payroll and benefits administration.
* Manage relationships with external legal counsel, tax advisors, banking institutions, and other statutory authorities.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and oversight to two (2\) finance staff and internal operational team members as applicable.


**Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting capabilities, controls, and operational efficiencies.
* Participate in global initiatives to enhance financial systems, planning processes, and reporting tools.
* Drive continuous improvement across finance operations.


**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualification and/or prior auditing experience are highly 10 years of progressive finance and accounting experience.
* At least 5 years in an Accounting Manager or equivalent leadership role.
* Minimum 3 years of supervisory experience.
* Extensive experience overseeing: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Bank Accounts, Financial Reporting, and Budgeting and Forecasting.
* Experience working within a service\-based organization.
* Previous experience working for a subsidiary of an international parent organization.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating cross\-border financial transactions and business activities.


**Technical Expertise**

The ideal candidate will possess:

* Strong knowledge of European accounting standards and financial reporting requirements.
* Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and auditing standards.
* Understanding of Swiss and EU tax regulations, VAT requirements, and fiscal policies.
* Advanced proficiency with ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial databases.
* Strong analytical, planning, and financial modeling skills.
* Experience with multinational financial operations and currency management.

Fluency in    required with a strong professional proficiency in **English** required as well.

**Personal Characteristics**

We are seeking a professional who demonstrates:

* Strategic thinking and sound business judgment.
* Strong leadership and collaboration attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
